_about: The particles (Čestice): what each does, its uses by corpus tag, cited ayat — docs/PARTICLES-PLAN.md. Validated on load (fil.particles.model); `fil particles check` holds counts, ayat and effects to the corpus.

grammar.bs: Najčešća riječ Kur'ana. Piše se spojeno s riječju iza sebe (وَقَالُوا). Kao veznik samo povezuje i ne mijenja padež: riječ iza nje uzima padež riječi s kojom se povezuje. Kao zakletva (وَٱلْعَصْرِ) je prijedlog i traži genitiv.
grammar.en: The most frequent word of the Quran. It is written joined to the word after it (وَقَالُوا). As a conjunction it only links and changes no case: the word after it takes the case of the word it is joined to. As an oath (وَٱلْعَصْرِ) it is a preposition and takes the genitive.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Uses shown: CONJ, REM, CIRC, P (oath), SUP (after the question hamza) and COM (accompaniment).
SUP: 51 of the 59 SUP wāws stand after the question hamza, 7 before لَٰكِنْ; the use says 'most often'.

COM: the corpus's three COM wāws (3:142, 10:71, 5:36); 5:36 is not cited. Ibn Hišām says the accompaniment wāw before a noun 'did not come in the Quran with certainty' and gives 10:71 both readings, as the use says.
The corpus tags some oath wāws at the head of a surah as CONJ (52:1, 51:1); examples are taken from P only.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section الواو المفردة: maṭlaq al-jamʿ (CONFIRMED), wāw al-istiʾnāf, wāw al-ḥāl, the oath wāw, the wāw of accompaniment and the Kufans' wāw aṣ-ṣarf (re-attributed: no Basran named); Sībawayh with the majority on أَوَ (الهمزة).

explanation.bs: Povezuje riječi i rečenice. Prema Ibn Hišāmu, sama وَ ne kaže šta je bilo prije: samo spaja (za redoslijed Kur'an koristi فَ i ثُمَّ). Riječ iza nje dijeli padež s riječju s kojom je povezana.
explanation.en: It joins words and sentences. According to Ibn Hišām, وَ by itself does not say which came first: it only joins (for order the Quran uses فَ and ثُمَّ). The word after it shares the case of the word it is joined to.

why.bs: وَعُيُونٍ je u genitivu kao i جَنَّٰتٍ s kojom je povezana.
why.en: وَعُيُونٍ is genitive like جَنَّٰتٍ, the word it is joined to.

why.bs: Glagol iza وَ je u subjunktivu jer je povezan s glagolom prije (كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ, 20:33).
why.en: The verb after وَ is subjunctive because it is joined to the verb before (كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ, 20:33).

explanation.bs: Korpus ovako označava وَ koja ne povezuje s prethodnom rečenicom nego otvara novu (al-istiʾnāf). Na bosanski se često prevodi s „a“ ili se ne prevodi.
explanation.en: The corpus marks this way a وَ that does not join to the sentence before but opens a new one (al-istiʾnāf). In English it is often “and” at the start of a sentence, or left out.

why.bs: Nakon naredbe „Čitaj!“ وَ otvara novu imensku rečenicu: „a Gospodar tvoj je najplemenitiji“.
why.en: After the command “Read!” وَ opens a new nominal sentence: “and your Lord is the Most Generous”.

why.bs: وَ otvara novu tvrdnju: „A drug vaš nije lud.“
why.en: وَ opens a new statement: “And your companion is not mad.”

explanation.bs: Uvodi rečenicu koja opisuje stanje u kojem se radnja dešava: „dok“, „a (oni)…“. Iza nje najčešće stoji zamjenica ili قَدْ.
explanation.en: It introduces a clause describing the state in which the action happens: “while”, “and (they)…”. A pronoun or قَدْ most often follows it.

why.bs: „…dok se on boji (Allaha)“ – opisuje stanje čovjeka koji je došao.
why.en: “…while he fears (Allah)” – the state of the man who came.

why.bs: „A On vas je stvorio u fazama“ – stanje uz prijekor iz prethodnog ajeta.
why.en: “While He has created you in stages” – the circumstance of the reproach in the ayah before.

explanation.bs: Na početku sure ili ajeta وَ je zakletva i prijedlog: imenica iza nje je u genitivu. Allah se kune Svojim stvorenjima da bi skrenuo pažnju na ono što slijedi.
explanation.en: At the start of a surah or an ayah وَ is an oath and a preposition: the noun after it is genitive. Allah swears by what He created to draw attention to what follows.

why.bs: „Tako mi vremena!“ – ٱلْعَصْرِ je u genitivu.
why.en: “By time!” – ٱلْعَصْرِ is genitive.

why.bs: „Tako mi jutra!“
why.en: “By the morning brightness!”

explanation.bs: Korpus ovako (SUP) bilježi وَ koja najčešće stoji iza hemze pitanja: أَوَلَمْ، أَوَلَوْ. Prema Sībawayhu i većini gramatičara, to je veznik rečenice koja slijedi, a hemza je stavljena ispred njega jer pitanje ide na početak (vidi أَ).
explanation.en: The corpus files so (SUP) a وَ that most often stands after the question hamza: أَوَلَمْ، أَوَلَوْ. According to Sībawayh and most grammarians it is the conjunction of the sentence that follows, and the hamza is put before it because a question goes first (see أَ).

why.bs: „Rekoše: ‘Zar ti nismo zabranili (da štitiš) svjetove?’“ – أَوَلَمْ.
why.en: “They said: ‘Have we not forbidden you from (protecting) people?’” – أَوَلَمْ.

why.bs: „Zar i naši preci?“ – أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا.
why.en: “And our forefathers (as well)?” – أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا.

explanation.bs: Imenica iza ove وَ je u akuzativu jer znači „zajedno s“ (al-mafʿūl maʿahu). U 10:71 tako je čita korpus; drugi je čitaju kao objekat podrazumijevanog glagola („i pozovite“).
explanation.en: The noun after this وَ is accusative because it means “together with” (al-mafʿūl maʿahu). In 10:71 the corpus reads it so; others read it as the object of an understood verb (“and call”).

why.bs: „…pa odlučite o svom planu zajedno s vašim ortacima“ – وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ u akuzativu.
why.en: “…so resolve upon your plan together with your partners” – وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ is accusative.

explanation.bs: Kad ova وَ veže glagol uz prethodni u smislu „a da ujedno…“, glagol je u subjunktivu. Kufski gramatičari je zovu „vav skretanja“ (wāw aṣ-ṣarf) i kažu da subjunktiv daje ona sama; Ibn Hišām to odbacuje: to je veznik koji glagol (s podrazumijevanim أَنْ) veže uz glagolsku imenicu koja se podrazumijeva prije.
explanation.en: When this وَ ties a verb to the one before in the sense “while at the same time…”, the verb is subjunctive. The Kufans call it the wāw of “turning away” (wāw aṣ-ṣarf) and say it makes the verb subjunctive itself; Ibn Hišām rejects this: it is the conjunction, joining the verb (with an understood أَنْ) to a verbal noun understood before it.

why.bs: „…a Allah još nije ukazao na one među vama koji se bore i, ujedno, na one koji su strpljivi“ – وَيَعْلَمَ u subjunktivu.
why.en: “…while Allah has not yet made evident those of you who strive and, at the same time, those who are steadfast” – وَيَعْلَمَ is subjunctive.

grammar.bs: Prijedlog: imenica iza njega je u genitivu (kasra na kraju: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). Zamjenica se na njega veže kao nastavak (مِنْهُ „od njega“). Pred članom se izgovara مِنَ (مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ).
grammar.en: A preposition: the noun after it is in the genitive (a kasra at the end: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). A pronoun is joined to it as a suffix (مِنْهُ “from him”). Before the article it is said مِنَ (مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ).

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section مِنْ (15 meanings): ibtidāʾ al-ġāya, tabʿīḍ, bayān al-jins and the additional مِنْ after a negation (at-tanṣīṣ ʿalā al-ʿumūm) — all CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Početak u prostoru ili vremenu (ibtidāʾ al-ġāya), često u paru s إِلَى „do“.
explanation.en: The start in space or time (ibtidāʾ al-ġāya), often paired with إِلَى “to”.

why.bs: „…od Svetog hrama do Najdaljeg hrama“.
why.en: “…from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa”.

title.en: “some of”: a part of a whole

explanation.bs: Izdvaja dio od cjeline (at-tabʿīḍ): „neki od ljudi“.
explanation.en: It takes a part of a whole (at-tabʿīḍ): “some of the people”.

why.bs: „A ima ljudi koji govore…“ – doslovno „od ljudi (su) oni koji…“.
why.en: “And of the people are some who say…”.

explanation.bs: Kaže od čega se nešto sastoji ili koje je vrste (bayān al-jins): „prljavština, to jest kipovi“.
explanation.en: It says what something consists of or what kind it is (bayān al-jins): “the filth, namely the idols”.

why.bs: „Klonite se prljavštine kumira“ – مِنَ objašnjava šta je ta prljavština.
why.en: “Avoid the uncleanliness of idols” – مِنَ says what that uncleanliness is.

explanation.bs: Iza negacije, ispred neodređene imenice, مِنْ pojačava: „nikakvog boga“. Ibn Hišām je naziva dodatnom (zāʾida): rečenica bi imala smisao i bez nje, ali je ona čini potpunom i bez izuzetka.
explanation.en: After a negation, before an indefinite noun, مِنْ strengthens it: “no god at all”. Ibn Hišām calls it additional (zāʾida): the sentence would make sense without it, but it makes it total, with no exception.

why.bs: „Vi drugog boga osim Njega nemate“ – مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ: nikakvog boga.
why.en: “You have no deity other than Him” – مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ: no deity at all.

grammar.bs: Piše se spojeno s riječju iza sebe. Kao veznik povezuje uz redoslijed i neposredno slijeđenje: prvo jedno, odmah zatim drugo (za razliku od ثُمَّ, uz razmak). Uvodi i odgovor uvjetne rečenice, a kad izražava uzrok iza naredbe ili zabrane, glagol iza nje je u subjunktivu.
grammar.en: It is written joined to the word after it. As a conjunction it joins with order and immediacy: first one, then at once the other (unlike ثُمَّ, with a gap). It also introduces the answer of a conditional sentence, and when it gives a consequence after a command or a prohibition, the verb after it is subjunctive.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Uses shown: CONJ, REM, RSLT, CAUS and SUP (after the question hamza).
SUP: 130 of the 155 SUP fāʾs stand after the question hamza; the rest are scattered; the use says 'most often'.
Review: 80:4 فَتَنفَعَهُ is Ḥafṣ's reading (others: indicative) — said in the ayah's note.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section الفاء المفردة: tartīb + taʿqīb (CONFIRMED), the fāʾ binding an answer, the subjunctive by an implied أَنْ against some Kufans (re-attributed); Muġnī does not grant a separate resumptive fāʾ (its tanbīh: 'it is said… the truth is it joins the sentence') — REM kept as the corpus's label, unattributed.

explanation.bs: Drugo slijedi odmah iza prvog (at-tartīb wa-t-taʿqīb, Ibn Hišām).
explanation.en: The second follows the first at once (at-tartīb wa-t-taʿqīb, Ibn Hišām).

why.bs: „…i (imetak) sabirao pa ga čuvao“: čuvanje odmah slijedi sabiranje.
why.en: “…and collected and then hoarded”: hoarding follows collecting at once.

why.bs: „Zatim ga usmrti pa ga u grob stavi“ – فَ: ukop slijedi smrt bez razmaka, a ثُمَّ uvodi smrt nakon života.
why.en: “Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him” – فَ: the burial follows death without a gap, while ثُمَّ brings death after a life.

explanation.bs: Korpus ovako označava فَ koja otvara novu rečenicu u nizu događaja ili zaključak iz rečenog.
explanation.en: The corpus marks this way a فَ that opens a new sentence in a run of events, or a conclusion from what was said.

why.bs: „Pa teško onima koji klanjaju, (107:5) a o namazu svome ne brinu“ – zaključak iz opisa prije.
why.en: “So woe to those who pray, (107:5) who are heedless of their prayer” – a conclusion from what was described before.

explanation.bs: Povezuje uvjet s njegovim odgovorom kad odgovor ne može stajati sam iza uvjeta (naredba, imenska rečenica, سَ/سَوْفَ…).
explanation.en: It links a condition to its answer when the answer cannot simply follow it (a command, a nominal sentence, سَ/سَوْفَ…).

why.bs: „Pa kad završiš, onda se trudi“ – odgovor je naredba, pa ide uz فَ.
why.en: “So when you have finished, then toil (in worship)” – the answer is a command, so it takes فَ.

why.bs: „…njegovo prebivalište će biti ponor“ – odgovor uvjeta iz 101:8 je imenska rečenica.
why.en: “…his refuge will be an abyss” – the answer to the condition of 101:8 is a nominal sentence.

explanation.bs: Iza naredbe, zabrane, pitanja, negacije ili nade (لَعَلَّ) فَ kaže šta bi uslijedilo, a glagol iza nje je u subjunktivu (fāʾ as-sababiyya). Prema Ibn Hišāmu, subjunktiv čini skriveno أَنْ, a ne sama فَ, kako su tvrdili neki kufski gramatičari.
explanation.en: After a command, a prohibition, a question, a negation or a hope (لَعَلَّ), فَ says what would follow, and the verb after it is subjunctive (fāʾ as-sababiyya). According to Ibn Hišām an implied أَنْ makes it so, not فَ itself as some Kufan grammarians held.

why.bs: „…možda bi pouku primio, pa da mu pouka koristi“ – تَنفَعَ u subjunktivu iza فَ nakon لَعَلَّ (80:3), u čitanju Hafsa; druga čitanja imaju indikativ.
why.en: “…or be reminded and the reminder would benefit him” – تَنفَعَ is subjunctive after فَ following لَعَلَّ (80:3), in Ḥafṣ's reading; other readings have the indicative.

why.bs: „…ne približavajte se ovom drvetu, pa da budete…“ – posljedica zabrane, تَكُونَا u subjunktivu.
why.en: “…do not approach this tree, lest you be…” – the consequence of a prohibition, تَكُونَا subjunctive.

explanation.bs: Korpus ovako (SUP) bilježi فَ koja najčešće stoji iza hemze pitanja: أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ „pa zar ne shvatate?“. Kao i kod أَوَ, prema Sībawayhu i većini gramatičara veznik pripada rečenici iza, a hemza stoji ispred jer pitanje ide na početak.
explanation.en: The corpus files so (SUP) a فَ that most often stands after the question hamza: أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ “will you not then reason?”. As with أَوَ, according to Sībawayh and most grammarians the conjunction belongs to the sentence after it, and the hamza stands first because a question goes first.

why.bs: „Pa zar se ne opominjete?“ – أَفَلَا.
why.en: “Then will you not be reminded?” – أَفَلَا.

why.bs: „Pa zar mi nećemo više umirati?“ – أَفَمَا.
why.en: “Then are we not to die?” – أَفَمَا.

meaning.en: for, belongs to; so that; let

grammar.bs: Piše se spojeno s riječju iza sebe. Ispred imenice je prijedlog (genitiv). Ispred glagola u sadašnjem obliku znači „da bi“ (subjunktiv) ili, kao لِ naredbe, „neka“ (jusiv).
grammar.en: It is written joined to the word after it. Before a noun it is a preposition (genitive). Before a present-tense verb it means “so that” (subjunctive) or, as the lām of command, “let” (jussive).

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: the corpus's P, PRP and IMPV lām. Its EMPH lām (لَـ of emphasis, 1001) has its own page (la-2) and its DIST lām (in ذَٰلِكَ) belongs to the demonstrative; both are left out.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section اللام المفردة: the lām of the genitive (istiḥqāq, iḫtiṣāṣ, milk), of purpose (implied أَنْ 'with the majority', against most Kufans — re-attributed) and of command (lām aṭ-ṭalab) — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Pripadanje, posjed, namjena: „hvala pripada Allahu“. Imenica iza je u genitivu. Sa zamjenicom: لَهُ „njemu, za njega“.
explanation.en: Belonging, possession, purpose: “praise belongs to Allah”. The noun after it is genitive. With a pronoun: لَهُ “his, for him”.

why.bs: „Hvala Allahu“ – ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: hvala pripada Allahu.
why.en: “All praise is due to Allah” – ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: praise belongs to Allah.

why.bs: „Allahovo je sve što je na nebesima…“ – لِلَّهِ: posjed.
why.en: “To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens…” – لِلَّهِ: possession.

explanation.bs: Ispred glagola kaže svrhu (lām at-taʿlīl ili lām kay); glagol je u subjunktivu. Prema većini gramatičara (al-jumhūr), subjunktiv čini skriveno أَنْ iza nje; većina kufskih kaže da ga čini sam lām.
explanation.en: Before a verb it gives the purpose (lām at-taʿlīl, or lām kay); the verb is subjunctive. According to most grammarians (al-jumhūr), an implied أَنْ after it makes it so; most Kufans say the lām itself does.

why.bs: „…da ti Allah oprosti…“ – يَغْفِرَ u subjunktivu.
why.en: “That Allah may forgive you…” – يَغْفِرَ is subjunctive.

why.bs: „Džinne i ljude sam stvorio samo zato da Me obožavaju“.
why.en: “I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me”.

explanation.bs: Ispred glagola u sadašnjem obliku daje naredbu trećem licu: „neka…“; glagol je u jusivu. Iza وَ ili فَ izgovara se bez vokala: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا.
explanation.en: Before a present-tense verb it gives a command to a third person: “let…”; the verb is jussive. After وَ or فَ it is said without a vowel: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا.

why.bs: „Neka zato obožavaju Gospodara ovog Hrama“ – يَعْبُدُوا u jusivu.
why.en: “Let them worship the Lord of this House” – يَعْبُدُوا is jussive.

why.bs: „Neka imućni troši prema svom imetku“.
why.en: “Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth”.

grammar.bs: Jedna riječ s više uloga. Kao čestica negira (مَا ضَلَّ „nije zalutao“), uz إِنَّ je sprečava da djeluje (إِنَّمَا „samo“), a s glagolom tvori glagolsku imenicu. Kao imenica znači „ono što“, „šta?“ ili „što god“. Ibn Hišām ih dijeli upravo tako: mā imenica i mā čestica.
grammar.en: One word with many roles. As a particle it negates (مَا ضَلَّ “he has not strayed”), stops إِنَّ from working (إِنَّمَا “only”) and turns a verb into a verbal noun. As a noun it means “what (that which)”, “what?” or “whatever”. Ibn Hišām divides it exactly so: mā the noun and mā the particle.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: NEG (with its كَان family), REL, INTG, PREV, SUB, COND and SUP; the two SUP uses share the tag.
The corpus tags إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ as PREV in 51:5 but REL in 77:7; neither is cited.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section ما: 'two aspects, nominal and particle' (CONFIRMED); negating, kāffa, maṣdariyya, relative, interrogative, conditional; the non-kāffa mā after a preposition (فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ) and after a jussive (إِمَّا، أَيْنَمَا) — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Negira glagol u prošlom vremenu (مَا ضَلَّ) ili imensku rečenicu (مَا هُوَ „on nije“). Kad negira imensku rečenicu kao لَيْسَ, korpus je stavlja u porodicu كَانَ; predikat tada često dolazi s بِـ.
explanation.en: It negates a past verb (مَا ضَلَّ) or a nominal sentence (مَا هُوَ “he is not”). When it negates a nominal sentence like لَيْسَ, the corpus puts it in the family of كَانَ; the predicate then often comes with بِـ.

why.bs: „Drug vaš nije zalutao niti je u zabludi“ – dvaput مَا s glagolom u prošlom vremenu.
why.en: “Your companion has not strayed, nor has he erred” – مَا twice, with a past verb.

why.bs: „A drug vaš nije lud“ – مَا kao لَيْسَ, predikat s بِـ.
why.en: “And your companion is not mad” – مَا like لَيْسَ, its predicate with بِـ.

explanation.bs: Imenica: „ono što“. Uvodi rečenicu koja je opisuje. Najčešća upotreba ove riječi u Kur'anu, prema korpusu.
explanation.en: A noun: “what, that which”. It introduces the clause that describes it. The most frequent use of this word in the Quran, as the corpus counts it.

why.bs: „Ja ne obožavam ono što vi obožavate“.
why.en: “I do not worship what you worship”.

why.bs: „…i dijele od onoga čime smo ih opskrbili“ – مِمَّا = مِنْ + مَا.
why.en: “…and spend out of what We have provided for them” – مِمَّا = مِنْ + مَا.

explanation.bs: Imenica u pitanju: „šta?“. U Kur'anu često pita da bi istakla veličinu nečega.
explanation.en: A noun asking “what?”. In the Quran it often asks to stress how great something is.

why.bs: „Šta je Neminovni čas?“ – pitanje koje ističe strahotu.
why.en: “What is the Inevitable Reality?” – a question that stresses its terror.

why.bs: „A šta je to u tvojoj desnici, o Musa?“
why.en: “And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”

explanation.bs: Spojena s إِنَّ, مَا je sprečava da djeluje (mā al-kāffa): imenica iza više nije u akuzativu. Zajedno znače „samo, zaista samo“.
explanation.en: Joined to إِنَّ, مَا stops it from working (mā al-kāffa): the noun after it is no longer accusative. Together they mean “only, indeed only”.

why.bs: „Vjernici su samo braća“ – ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ je u nominativu, ne u akuzativu.
why.en: “The believers are but brothers” – ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ is nominative, not accusative.

why.bs: „Imeci vaši i djeca vaša su samo iskušenje“ – أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ u nominativu.
why.en: “Your wealth and your children are but a trial” – أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ nominative.

explanation.bs: S glagolom iza sebe čini cjelinu koja vrijedi kao imenica (mā al-maṣdariyya); često u كَمَا „kao što“.
explanation.en: With the verb after it, it makes a whole that stands as a noun (mā al-maṣdariyya); often in كَمَا “as”.

why.bs: „…kao što su me oni odgojili“ – كَمَا: kao (njihov) odgoj mene.
why.en: “…as they brought me up” – كَمَا: like (their) bringing me up.

explanation.bs: Uvjetna riječ (imenica): „što god“. Glagoli uvjeta i odgovora su u jusivu.
explanation.en: A noun of condition: “whatever”. The verbs of the condition and its answer are jussive.

why.bs: „Što god dokinemo od ajeta…“ – نَنسَخْ u jusivu.
why.en: “Whatever verse We abrogate…” – نَنسَخْ is jussive.

why.bs: „A što god udijelite…“
why.en: “And whatever you spend…”

title.en: Between a preposition and its noun: emphasis

explanation.bs: مَا koja se dodaje radi naglašavanja (zāʾida): prema Ibn Hišāmu ne ukida djelovanje, pa je imenica iza prijedloga i dalje u genitivu: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ „samo zbog milosti“.
explanation.en: A مَا added for emphasis (zāʾida): according to Ibn Hišām it does not cancel the governing, so the noun after the preposition is still genitive: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ “it is by mercy”.

why.bs: „Samo zbog Allahove milosti ti si blag prema njima“ – رَحْمَةٍ u genitivu.
why.en: “So by mercy from Allah, you were lenient with them” – رَحْمَةٍ is genitive.

why.bs: „Zbog toga što su prekršili svoj zavjet…“ – نَقْضِهِم u genitivu.
why.en: “And because of their breaking of the covenant…” – نَقْضِهِم is genitive.

title.bs: Uz uvjet: إِمَّا، أَيْنَمَا، إِذَا مَا
title.en: With a condition: إِمَّا، أَيْنَمَا، إِذَا مَا

explanation.bs: Dodana مَا često stoji uz riječi uvjeta i naglašava ih: إِنْ + مَا = إِمَّا, أَيْنَ + مَا = أَيْنَمَا.
explanation.en: The added مَا often stands with words of condition and stresses them: إِنْ + مَا = إِمَّا, أَيْنَ + مَا = أَيْنَمَا.

why.bs: „A ako te šejtan nečim podstakne…“ – وَإِمَّا.
why.en: “And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan…” – وَإِمَّا.

why.bs: „Ma gdje bili, stići će vas smrt“ – أَيْنَمَا.
why.en: “Wherever you may be, death will overtake you” – أَيْنَمَا.

grammar.bs: Prijedlog: imenica iza njega je u genitivu (kasra na kraju: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). Zamjenica se na njega veže kao nastavak (بِهِ „s njim, njime“). Piše se spojeno s riječju iza sebe (بِسْمِ). Njeno osnovno značenje je „dodir, vezanost“ (al-ilṣāq; kod Sībawayha: al-ilzāq).
grammar.en: A preposition: the noun after it is in the genitive (a kasra at the end: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). A pronoun is joined to it as a suffix (بِهِ “with it”). It is written joined to the word after it (بِسْمِ). Its basic meaning is “contact, attachment” (al-ilṣāq; Sībawayh's own word is al-ilzāq).

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Sībawayh, al-Kitāb

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section الباء المفردة: ilṣāq ('therefore Sībawayh confined himself to it'), taʿdiya with 2:17 itself, istiʿāna, ẓarfiyya, the additional bāʾ in a negative predicate (ليس زيد بقائم، وما الله بغافل) — CONFIRMED. Sībawayh's own word al-ilzāq: CONFIRMED in al-Kitāb (OpenITI 0180Sibawayhi.KitabSibawayhi.Shamela0023018-ara1, 'وباء الجر إنما هي للإلزاق والاختلاط').

explanation.bs: Sredstvo kojim se nešto radi (al-istiʿāna).
explanation.en: The means by which something is done (al-istiʿāna).

why.bs: „Koji je poučio pomoću pera“ – بِٱلْقَلَمِ.
why.en: “Who taught by the pen” – بِٱلْقَلَمِ.

explanation.bs: Kao فِي: mjesto ili vrijeme (aẓ-ẓarfiyya).
explanation.en: Like فِي: a place or a time (aẓ-ẓarfiyya).

why.bs: „Allah vam je pomogao na Bedru“ – بِبَدْرٍ: na Bedru.
why.en: “Allah had already given you victory at Badr” – بِبَدْرٍ: at Badr.

explanation.bs: Uz glagol kretanja čini da subjekt nosi nešto sa sobom (at-taʿdiya): ذَهَبَ „otišao“, ذَهَبَ بِـ „odnio“. Ibn Hišām navodi baš ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: With a verb of motion it makes the subject carry something along (at-taʿdiya): ذَهَبَ “went”, ذَهَبَ بِـ “took away”. Ibn Hišām cites this very ayah.

why.bs: „…Allah im odnese svjetlo“ – ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ.
why.en: “…Allah took away their light” – ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ.

explanation.bs: U predikatu iza لَيْسَ ili مَا pojačava negaciju; Ibn Hišām je naziva dodatnom (zāʾida). Ne prevodi se.
explanation.en: In the predicate after لَيْسَ or مَا it strengthens the negation; Ibn Hišām calls it additional (zāʾida). It is not translated.

why.bs: „Zar Allah nije dovoljan robu Svome?“ – بِكَافٍ.
why.en: “Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant?” – بِكَافٍ.

why.bs: „…a oni nisu vjernici“ – بِمُؤْمِنِينَ.
why.en: “…but they are not believers” – بِمُؤْمِنِينَ.

meaning.en: not; do not; there is no

grammar.bs: Najčešća negacija u Kur'anu. Ispred glagola u sadašnjem obliku negira ne mijenjajući ga (indikativ ostaje). Kao zabrana („nemoj“) stavlja glagol u jusiv. Kao لَا koja negira cijeli rod djeluje kao إِنَّ: imenica iza nje ima fethu bez nunacije.
grammar.en: The most frequent negation in the Quran. Before a present-tense verb it negates without changing it (the indicative stays). As a prohibition (“do not”) it puts the verb in the jussive. As the lā that denies a whole kind it works like إِنَّ: the noun after it takes a fatḥa without nunation.

NEG|FAM:كَان: the corpus tags 5:109 لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ (an accusative, the لَا of the kind) under it; not cited. The non-governing reading of لَا خَوْفٌ is named beside the corpus's.
Review: 2:254 بَيْعٌ is Ḥafṣ's reading; Ibn Kaṯīr and Abū ʿAmr read the fatḥa (لَا of the kind) — said in the ayah's note.

The corpus files some prohibitions as NEG (31:13, 9:40: NEG with a jussive verb) and some لَا إِلَٰهَ as NEG (37:35), so the per-use counts are the corpus's tags, not a full count of each use; examples are taken only where the corpus tags the use as claimed.

Review: the none-at-all use claims no effect — for a simple noun Muġnī says it is built on the fatḥa (its accusative ending; as-Sīrāfī and az-Zajjāj held it declined), while the corpus tags ACC; the text says both.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section لا: the لَا of the kind (built on the fatḥa — re-attributed from 'the Basrans' to Muġnī's own statement), لَا like لَيْسَ, the negating and the prohibiting لَا — uses CONFIRMED. The 2:254 qirāʾa readers are not a Muġnī claim (not checked here).

explanation.bs: Negira sadašnji ili budući glagol; glagol ostaje u indikativu.
explanation.en: It negates a present or future verb; the verb stays indicative.

why.bs: „Ja ne obožavam…“ – أَعْبُدُ ostaje u indikativu.
why.en: “I do not worship…” – أَعْبُدُ stays indicative.

why.bs: „…oni neće vjerovati“.
why.en: “…they will not believe”.

explanation.bs: Zabrana (lā an-nāhiya): glagol u sadašnjem obliku dolazi u jusivu.
explanation.en: A prohibition (lā an-nāhiya): the present-tense verb comes in the jussive.

why.bs: „Zato siroče ne ugnjetavaj“ – تَقْهَرْ u jusivu.
why.en: “So as for the orphan, do not oppress (him)” – تَقْهَرْ is jussive.

why.bs: „Zato ne slušaj one koji poriču“ – تُطِعِ u jusivu (kesra samo zbog izgovora uz ٱلْ).
why.en: “Then do not obey the deniers” – تُطِعِ is jussive (the kasra only joins it to ٱلْ).

title.en: “there is no … at all”: denying the kind

explanation.bs: Negira cijeli rod (lā an-nāfiya li-l-jins) i djeluje kao إِنَّ: imenica iza nje ima fethu bez nunacije (لَا رَيْبَ). Prema Ibn Hišāmu, jednostavna imenica tu je nepromjenljiva (mebnij) na fethi, završetku koji bi imala u akuzativu; korpus je bilježi kao akuzativ i stavlja لَا u porodicu إِنَّ.
explanation.en: It denies a whole kind (lā an-nāfiya li-l-jins) and works like إِنَّ: the noun after it takes a fatḥa without nunation (لَا رَيْبَ). According to Ibn Hišām a simple noun there is fixed (built) on the fatḥa, the ending it would have as an accusative; the corpus tags it accusative and puts لَا in the family of إِنَّ.

why.bs: „U to nema nikakve sumnje“ – رَيْبَ s fethom, bez nunacije.
why.en: “About which there is no doubt” – رَيْبَ with a fatḥa, without nunation.

why.bs: „Allah – nema boga osim Njega“ – إِلَٰهَ s fethom, bez nunacije.
why.en: “Allah – there is no deity except Him” – إِلَٰهَ with a fatḥa, without nunation.

explanation.bs: Korpus ovako bilježi لَا koja radi kao لَيْسَ: imenica iza nje ostaje u nominativu, s tenvinom. Drugi je čitaju kao لَا koja ništa ne mijenja, a imenica je subjekat; u oba čitanja imenica je u nominativu. Uporedi لَا roda (لَا رَيْبَ), iza koje je imenica s fethom.
explanation.en: The corpus files so a لَا that works like لَيْسَ: the noun after it stays nominative, with tanwīn. Others read it as a لَا that changes nothing, the noun being the subject; in either reading the noun is nominative. Compare the لَا of the kind (لَا رَيْبَ), after which the noun has a fatḥa.

why.bs: „…nikakva straha za njih neće biti, niti će oni tugovati“ – خَوْفٌ u nominativu.
why.en: “…there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve” – خَوْفٌ is nominative.

why.bs: „…prije nego što dođe dan kad neće biti ni trgovine…“ – بَيْعٌ u nominativu u Ḥafṣovom čitanju; Ibn Kaṯīr i Abū ʿAmr čitaju لَا بَيْعَ, s fethom (لَا roda).
why.en: “…before there comes a Day in which there is no exchange…” – بَيْعٌ is nominative in Ḥafṣ's reading; Ibn Kaṯīr and Abū ʿAmr read لَا بَيْعَ, with a fatḥa (the لَا of the kind).

grammar.bs: Prijedlog: imenica iza njega je u genitivu (kasra na kraju: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). Zamjenica se na njega veže kao nastavak (فِيهِ „u njemu“).
grammar.en: A preposition: the noun after it is in the genitive (a kasra at the end: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). A pronoun is joined to it as a suffix (فِيهِ “in it”).

explanation.bs: Ono u čemu se nešto nalazi (aẓ-ẓarfiyya).
explanation.en: That in which something is (aẓ-ẓarfiyya).

why.bs: „…u vrtovima i kod izvora“.
why.en: “In gardens and springs”.

why.bs: „…na Ploči pomno čuvanoj“.
why.en: “…on a Preserved Slate”.

explanation.bs: Vrijeme u kojem se nešto dešava.
explanation.en: The time in which something happens.

why.bs: „I spominjite Allaha u određenim danima“.
why.en: “And remember Allah during specific days”.

why.bs: „…za nekoliko godina“.
why.en: “Within three to nine years”.

explanation.bs: Uzrok (at-taʿlīl); Ibn Hišām među primjerima navodi i ovaj ajet: „zbog onoga u što ste se upustili“. Može se čitati i kao „u vezi s onim“.
explanation.en: The cause (at-taʿlīl); Ibn Hišām gives this ayah among his examples: “because of what you plunged into”. It can also be read as “in the matter of”.

why.bs: „…zbog onoga u što ste se upustili“ – فِيمَا = فِي + مَا.
why.en: “…for that in which you were involved” – فِيمَا = فِي + مَا.

grammar.bs: Pojačava imensku rečenicu. Njen subjekt je u akuzativu (إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ), a predikat ostaje u nominativu. Ima „sestre“ koje djeluju isto: أَنَّ, كَأَنَّ, لَٰكِنَّ, لَيْتَ, لَعَلَّ. Iza riječi „reći“, kad uvodi navod, dolazi إِنَّ, a ne أَنَّ.
grammar.en: It strengthens a nominal sentence. Its subject is accusative (إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ) and its predicate stays nominative. It has “sisters” that work the same way: أَنَّ, كَأَنَّ, لَٰكِنَّ, لَيْتَ, لَعَلَّ. After the word “say”, when it introduces a quotation, it is إِنَّ, not أَنَّ.

explanation.bs: Potvrđuje rečenicu. Subjekt iza nje je u akuzativu.
explanation.en: It confirms the sentence. The subject after it is accusative.

why.bs: „Allah je zaista uz strpljive“ – ٱللَّهَ u akuzativu.
why.en: “Indeed, Allah is with the patient” – ٱللَّهَ accusative.

why.bs: „Čovjek je doista na gubitku“ – uz لَـ u predikatu: dvostruko pojačanje.
why.en: “Indeed, mankind is in loss” – with لَـ in the predicate: emphasis twice over.

explanation.bs: Iza glagola „reći“ (قَالَ) navod počinje s إِنَّ (s kesrom).
explanation.en: After the verb “say” (قَالَ) the quotation begins with إِنَّ (with kasra).

why.bs: „…kad Musa reče narodu svome: ‘Allah vam naređuje…’“
why.en: “…when Moses said to his people, ‘Indeed, Allah commands you…’”

grammar.bs: Prijedlog: imenica iza njega je u genitivu (kasra na kraju: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). Zamjenica se na njega veže kao nastavak (عَلَيْهِ „na njemu“ – ى postaje يْ).
grammar.en: A preposition: the noun after it is in the genitive (a kasra at the end: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). A pronoun is joined to it as a suffix (عَلَيْهِ “on him” – ى becomes يْ).

explanation.bs: Biti na nečemu, iznad nečega (al-istiʿlāʾ) – osnovno značenje, doslovno ili preneseno.
explanation.en: Being on, above something (al-istiʿlāʾ) – the basic meaning, literal or figurative.

why.bs: „…na divanima zlatom protkanim“.
why.en: “On thrones woven (with gold)”.

why.bs: „Mir Ibrahimu!“ – doslovno „mir na Ibrahima“.
why.en: “Peace upon Abraham.”

explanation.bs: Preneseno: obaveza leži na nekome.
explanation.en: Figuratively: a duty lies upon someone.

why.bs: „A Allahu je na ljudima obaveza hodočašća Hrama“ – عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ.
why.en: “And (due) to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House” – عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ.

explanation.bs: Uz glagol oslanjanja (تَوَكَّلَ) kaže na koga se čovjek oslanja.
explanation.en: With the verb of reliance (تَوَكَّلَ) it says on whom one relies.

why.bs: „A na Allaha neka se vjernici oslone“.
why.en: “And upon Allah the believers should rely”.

grammar.bs: لَـ s fethom (lām al-ibtidāʾ i lām odgovora na zakletvu) je druga riječ od لِـ s kesrom: ne mijenja padež ni način, nego naglašava. Najčešće stoji u predikatu iza إِنَّ (إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ), u odgovoru na zakletvu, u odgovoru na لَوْ i iza olakšanog إِنْ.
grammar.en: لَـ with a fatḥa (lām al-ibtidāʾ and the lām answering an oath) is a different word from لِـ with a kasra: it changes no case or mood, it stresses. It mostly stands on the predicate after إِنَّ (إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ), in the answer to an oath, in the answer to لَوْ and after the lightened إِنْ.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section اللام المفردة, 'the non-governing lāms': lām al-ibtidāʾ, the muzaḥlaqa in the predicate of إِنَّ, the lām answering لَوْ / لَوْلَا / an oath — CONFIRMED; the lām after the lightened إِنْ re-attributed (Sībawayh and most / al-Fārisī and Ibn Ǧinnī / the Kufans).

explanation.bs: Lām naglašavanja po pravilu stoji na početku rečenice, ali kad rečenicu otvara إِنَّ, dvije riječi naglašavanja se ne stavljaju jednu do druge, pa se lām pomjera na predikat ili na subjekat koji je odgođen (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). Lām ne mijenja padež: riječ zadržava padež koji ima u rečenici.
explanation.en: The lām of emphasis belongs at the head of the sentence, but when إِنَّ opens it the two words of emphasis are not put side by side, so the lām moves to the predicate, or to the subject when that comes late (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The lām changes no case: the word keeps the case it has in the sentence.

why.bs: „Vaš Bog je zaista Jedan“ – لَوَٰحِدٌ je predikat od إِنَّ, u nominativu.
why.en: “Indeed, your God is One” – لَوَٰحِدٌ is the predicate of إِنَّ, nominative.

why.bs: „A nad vama su zaista čuvari“ – لَحَٰفِظِينَ je subjekat od إِنَّ koji dolazi poslije, zato u akuzativu.
why.en: “And indeed, over you are keepers” – لَحَٰفِظِينَ is the subject of إِنَّ coming late, hence accusative.

explanation.bs: Kad se Allah zakune ili je zakletva podrazumijevana, glagol odgovora dobiva لَـ, a u sadašnjem obliku najčešće i ـنَّ naglašavanja (لَتَرَوُنَّ). Isti lām stoji u لَقَدْ.
explanation.en: When Allah swears, or an oath is understood, the verb of the answer takes لَـ, and in the present tense most often also the ـنَّ of emphasis (لَتَرَوُنَّ). The same lām stands in لَقَدْ.

why.bs: „Sigurno ćete vidjeti Džehennem!“ – لَـ i ـنَّ odgovaraju na podrazumijevanu zakletvu.
why.en: “You will surely see the Hellfire!” – لَـ and ـنَّ answer an oath that is understood.

why.bs: „Reci: ‘Hoćete, tako mi Gospodara moga, sigurno ćete biti oživljeni!’“ – zakletva وَرَبِّى i njen odgovor لَتُبْعَثُنَّ.
why.en: “Say: ‘Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected!’” – the oath وَرَبِّى and its answer لَتُبْعَثُنَّ.

why.bs: „Mi smo zaista stvorili čovjeka u najljepšem obliku“ – لَقَدْ: lām odgovora na zakletve iz ajeta 1–3 i قَدْ.
why.en: “We have certainly created man in the best of stature” – لَقَدْ: the lām answering the oaths of ayat 1–3, with قَدْ.

title.en: The answer to لَوْ and لَوْلَا

explanation.bs: Glagol u prošlom obliku koji odgovara na لَوْ ili لَوْلَا često dobiva لَـ; ponekad ga nema (لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًا, 56:70).
explanation.en: A past-tense verb answering لَوْ or لَوْلَا often takes لَـ; sometimes it does not (لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًا, 56:70).

why.bs: „Da hoćemo, učinili bismo ga smrvljenim“ – لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ odgovara na لَوْ.
why.en: “If We willed, We could make it crumbled debris” – لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ answers لَوْ.

why.bs: „Da nije blagodati Gospodara moga, i ja bih bio među dovedenima“ – لَكُنتُ odgovara na لَوْلَا.
why.en: “If not for the favour of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in” – لَكُنتُ answers لَوْلَا.

title.en: At the head of a sentence

explanation.bs: Bez إِنَّ lām naglašavanja stoji na početku imenske rečenice (lām al-ibtidāʾ): „zaista je…“. Subjekat iza njega ostaje u nominativu.
explanation.en: Without إِنَّ the lām of emphasis heads a nominal sentence (lām al-ibtidāʾ): “surely…”. The subject after it stays nominative.

why.bs: „Vi zaista izazivate veći strah u njihovim srcima nego Allah“ – لَأَنتُمْ.
why.en: “You are more fearful in their breasts than Allah” – لَأَنتُمْ.

why.bs: „Stvaranje nebesa i Zemlje je zaista veće od stvaranja ljudi“ – لَخَلْقُ u nominativu.
why.en: “The creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind” – لَخَلْقُ is nominative.

explanation.bs: Iza إِنْ olakšanog od إِنَّ dolazi لَـ. Prema Sībawayhu i većini gramatičara to je lām naglaska koji ujedno razlikuje potvrdno إِنْ od negacije; al-Fārisī, Ibn Ǧinnī i drugi smatraju ga posebnim lāmom razlikovanja (al-lām al-fāriqa); kufski kažu da je إِنْ tu negacija, a لَـ znači إِلَّا. Vidi إِنْ.
explanation.en: After إِنْ lightened from إِنَّ comes لَـ. According to Sībawayh and most grammarians it is the lām of emphasis, which also tells the affirming إِنْ apart from the negating one; al-Fārisī, Ibn Ǧinnī and others take it as a separate lām of distinction (al-lām al-fāriqa); the Kufans say إِنْ is a negation there and لَـ means إِلَّا. See إِنْ.

why.bs: „Tako nam Allaha, bili smo zaista u očitoj zabludi“ – إِن كُنَّا لَفِى.
why.en: “By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error” – إِن كُنَّا لَفِى.

why.bs: „…i mi zaista mislimo da si ti od lažaca“ – إِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ.
why.en: “…and indeed, we think you are among the liars” – إِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ.

grammar.bs: Riječ za osobe (ono što ima razum), kao što je مَا za stvari. Korpus je bilježi kao imenicu bez korijena. Ima tri uloge: odnosna („onaj koji“), uvjetna („ko god“, stavlja glagole u jusiv) i upitna („ko?“). Sama se ne mijenja po padežima.
grammar.en: The word for persons (beings with reason), as مَا is for things. The corpus files it as a rootless noun. It has three roles: relative (“the one who”), conditional (“whoever”, putting the verbs in the jussive) and interrogative (“who?”). It does not change for case itself.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: REL (650), COND (184) and INTG (37).
The corpus tags 20:49 فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا as REL though it is a question; it is not cited.
Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section مَنْ (four aspects): conditional, interrogative, relative — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Uvodi rečenicu koja opisuje osobu; glagol iza ostaje u svom načinu.
explanation.en: It introduces a clause describing a person; the verb after it keeps its own mood.

why.bs: „Poruku će primiti onaj koji se boji“ – مَن يَخْشَىٰ.
why.en: “He who fears will be reminded” – مَن يَخْشَىٰ.

why.bs: „Svako ko je na njoj prolazan je“ – كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا.
why.en: “Everyone upon it will perish” – كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا.

explanation.bs: Kao uvjet stavlja glagol uvjeta i glagol odgovora u sadašnjem obliku u jusiv.
explanation.en: As a condition it puts the present-tense verbs of the condition and of the answer in the jussive.

why.bs: „Pa ko bude uradio koliko trun dobra, vidjet će ga“ – يَعْمَلْ i يَرَهُ u jusivu.
why.en: “So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it” – يَعْمَلْ and يَرَهُ are jussive.

why.bs: „A ko bude uradio koliko trun zla, vidjet će ga.“
why.en: “And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.”

explanation.bs: Pita o osobi. Često pitanje znači poricanje: مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ „ko je taj koji će se zauzimati…?“ – niko, osim s Njegovom dozvolom.
explanation.en: It asks about a person. A question is often a denial: مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ “who is it that can intercede…?” – no one, except by His permission.

why.bs: „I reći će se: ‘Ko je vidar?’“ – مَنْ رَاقٍ.
why.en: “And it is said: ‘Who will cure him?’” – مَنْ رَاقٍ.

why.bs: „Ko se može zauzimati kod Njega osim s Njegovim dopuštenjem?“
why.en: “Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission?”

grammar.bs: Prijedlog: imenica iza njega je u genitivu (kasra na kraju: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). Zamjenica se na njega veže kao nastavak (إِلَيْهِ „k njemu“ – ى postaje يْ).
grammar.en: A preposition: the noun after it is in the genitive (a kasra at the end: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). A pronoun is joined to it as a suffix (إِلَيْهِ “to him” – ى becomes يْ).

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Muġnī (إلى, meaning 2) gives maʿa to the Kufans and some Basrans with 3:52, not 4:2; it explains 4:2 by taḍmīn (after az-Zamaḫšarī, Bāb 8) and states the Basrans' rule that prepositions do not stand for one another (الباء, tanbīh). 3:52 added; 4:2 kept as the taḍmīn reading.
Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section إلى (eight meanings): intihāʾ al-ġāya of place and time — CONFIRMED; maʿa REWORDED (see the note above).

explanation.bs: Krajnja tačka kretanja (intihāʾ al-ġāya), u paru s مِنْ.
explanation.en: The end point of a movement (intihāʾ al-ġāya), paired with مِنْ.

why.bs: „…do Najdaljeg hrama“.
why.en: “…to al-Masjid al-Aqsa”.

why.bs: „Ka Gospodaru tvome je, zaista, povratak“.
why.en: “Indeed, to your Lord is the return”.

explanation.bs: Krajnja tačka u vremenu.
explanation.en: The end point in time.

why.bs: „…zatim upotpunite post do noći“.
why.en: “…then complete the fast until the night”.

explanation.bs: Kad se jedno pridružuje drugom, إِلَى može značiti „zajedno s“ (al-maʿiyya): Ibn Hišām navodi da tako kažu kufski i dio basranskih gramatičara, uz 3:52. Basranska škola smatra da jedan prijedlog ne stoji umjesto drugog; u 4:2 Ibn Hišām, za az-Zamaḫšarījem, glagol „jesti“ čita sa skrivenim značenjem „pridružiti“ (at-taḍmīn).
explanation.en: When one thing is added to another, إِلَى can mean “together with” (al-maʿiyya): Ibn Hišām reports this from the Kufans and some Basrans, with 3:52. The Basran school holds that one preposition does not stand for another; in 4:2 Ibn Hišām, after az-Zamaḫšarī, reads “consume” with an implied sense of “add” (at-taḍmīn).

why.bs: „Ko su moji pomagači (zajedno) s Allahom?“ – značenje maʿa koje Ibn Hišām navodi od kufskih i dijela basranskih; prevodi se i „na Allahovom putu“.
why.en: “Who are my helpers (together) with Allah?” – the maʿa sense Ibn Hišām reports from the Kufans and some Basrans; it is also rendered “for (the cause of) Allah”.

why.bs: „…i ne jedite imetke njihove (pridružujući ih) vašim imecima“ – „jesti“ sa skrivenim značenjem „pridružiti“ (at-taḍmīn).
why.en: “…and do not consume their properties into your own” – “consume” with the implied sense of “add” (at-taḍmīn).

grammar.bs: Dvije česte uloge. Kao uvjet („ako“) stavlja glagole uvjeta i odgovora u sadašnjem obliku u jusiv. Kao negacija znači „ne“, najčešće uz إِلَّا: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا… „to nije ništa drugo nego…“.
grammar.en: Two frequent roles. As a condition (“if”) it puts present-tense verbs of the condition and the answer in the jussive. As a negation it means “not”, mostly with إِلَّا: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا… “it is nothing but…”.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: COND, NEG and CERT (the lightened إِنَّ). The corpus files the same lightened إِنْ as COND in 37:167 and 17:73; only CERT ayat are cited.

The lām after the lightened إِنْ is given as Muġnī states it (اللام, fasl): Sībawayh and most — lām al-ibtidāʾ that also tells it apart; al-Fārisī and Ibn Ǧinnī — a separate lām; the Kufans — إِنْ negates, لَـ = إِلَّا. 20:63 is a qirāʾa question, named without listing the readers.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section إن المكسورة الخفيفة (four aspects): conditional, negating, lightened from إِنَّ — CONFIRMED; the lām re-attributed (see the note above).

explanation.bs: Uvjet koji se može i ne mora ostvariti. Glagol u sadašnjem obliku iza nje je u jusivu.
explanation.en: A condition that may or may not be fulfilled. A present-tense verb after it is jussive.

why.bs: „Ako pomognete Allaha, i On će vama pomoći“ – oba glagola u jusivu.
why.en: “If you support Allah, He will support you” – both verbs jussive.

explanation.bs: Znači isto što i مَا „ne“; uz إِلَّا ograničava: „samo“.
explanation.en: It means the same as مَا “not”; with إِلَّا it restricts: “only”.

why.bs: „To je samo objava koja mu se obznanjuje“ – إِنْ…إِلَّا.
why.en: “It is not but a revelation revealed” – إِنْ…إِلَّا.

why.bs: „Ti si samo opominjač“.
why.en: “You are not but a warner”.

explanation.bs: إِنْ olakšano od إِنَّ (al-muḫaffafa) potvrđuje, a predikat mu dobiva لَـ. Prema Sībawayhu i većini gramatičara to je إِنَّ olakšano, a لَـ je lām naglaska koji ujedno razlikuje potvrdu od negacije; kufski kažu da je إِنْ tu negacija, a لَـ znači إِلَّا („nismo bili nego u zabludi“). Smisao je u oba čitanja isti.
explanation.en: إِنْ lightened from إِنَّ (al-muḫaffafa) affirms, and its predicate takes لَـ. According to Sībawayh and most grammarians it is the lightened إِنَّ, and لَـ is the lām of emphasis that also tells affirming from negating; the Kufans say إِنْ is a negation there and لَـ means إِلَّا (“we were nothing but in error”). The sense is the same either way.

why.bs: „Tako nam Allaha, bili smo zaista u očitoj zabludi.“
why.en: “By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error.”

why.bs: „Ova dvojica su zaista čarobnjaci“ – u Ḥafṣovom čitanju إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ; neki drugi učači čitaju إِنَّ (Abū ʿAmr: إِنَّ هَٰذَيْنِ).
why.en: “Indeed, these are two magicians” – in Ḥafṣ's reading إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ; some other readers read إِنَّ (Abū ʿAmr: إِنَّ هَٰذَيْنِ).

grammar.bs: Izuzima. U potvrdnoj rečenici ono što izuzima je u akuzativu. Iza negacije ograničava: „nije … osim“ = „samo“, a riječ iza zadržava padež koji joj rečenica daje.
grammar.en: It excepts. In an affirmative sentence what it excepts is accusative. After a negation it restricts: “not … except” = “only”, and the word after it keeps the case its sentence gives it.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section إلا (four aspects): exception (and the exception after a negation) — CONFIRMED; no attributed claim.

explanation.bs: Izuzima iz potvrdne rečenice; izuzeto je u akuzativu.
explanation.en: It excepts from an affirmative sentence; what is excepted is accusative.

why.bs: „…osim onih koji klanjaju“ – ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ u akuzativu.
why.en: “Except the observers of prayer” – ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ accusative.

why.bs: „Probdij noć, osim malog dijela“ – قَلِيلًا u akuzativu.
why.en: “Arise (to pray) the night, except for a little” – قَلِيلًا accusative.

explanation.bs: Iza negacije (مَا, إِنْ, لَا) ograničava tvrdnju na jedno: „nije ništa drugo nego“.
explanation.en: After a negation (مَا, إِنْ, لَا) it restricts the statement to one thing: “nothing but”.

why.bs: „Muhammed je samo poslanik“ – رَسُولٌ ostaje u nominativu.
why.en: “Muhammad is not but a messenger” – رَسُولٌ stays nominative.

why.bs: „Nema boga osim Allaha“.
why.en: “There is no deity but Allah”.

grammar.bs: Sa glagolom iza sebe čini cjelinu koja vrijedi kao imenica (أَنْ تَصُومُوا = „post“). Glagol u sadašnjem obliku iza nje je u subjunktivu.
grammar.en: With the verb after it, it makes a whole that stands as a noun (أَنْ تَصُومُوا = “fasting”). A present-tense verb after it is subjunctive.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section أن المفتوحة الخفيفة: 'a verbal-noun particle that puts the present in the subjunctive' — CONFIRMED; the mufassira REWORDED: Muġnī lists its conditions for 'those who affirm it' and says of the Kufans' denial 'وهو عندي متجه'.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām je naziva maṣdarskom i onom koja stavlja u subjunktiv (al-maṣdariyya an-nāṣiba).
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām calls it the one that makes a verbal noun and puts the verb in the subjunctive (al-maṣdariyya an-nāṣiba).

why.bs: „A da postite, bolje vam je“ – تَصُومُوا u subjunktivu.
why.en: “But to fast is best for you” – تَصُومُوا is subjunctive.

why.bs: „Allah želi da vam olakša“.
why.en: “Allah wants to lighten for you”.

explanation.bs: Iza riječi koja znači govor, ali nije „reći“ (objaviti, pozvati), أَنْ kaže sadržaj: „…da“. Gramatičari koji je priznaju zovu je tumačećom (al-mufassira) i postavljaju joj uvjete; kufski je ne priznaju, a Ibn Hišām njihovo mišljenje smatra opravdanim. Ne mijenja glagol.
explanation.en: After a word that means speech but is not “say” (reveal, call), أَنْ gives the content: “…that”. Grammarians who accept it call it the explaining one (al-mufassira) and set conditions for it; the Kufans deny it, and Ibn Hišām finds their view sound. It does not change the verb.

why.bs: „Mi ga zovnusmo: ‘O Ibrahime…’“
why.en: “We called to him, ‘O Abraham…’”

why.bs: „I Mi mu objavismo: ‘Gradi lađu…’“
why.en: “So We inspired to him, ‘Construct the ship…’”

grammar.bs: Hemza pitanja otvara pitanje i ne mijenja padež ni način. Prema Ibn Hišāmu, razlikuje se od هَلْ jer može pitati i „ovo ili ono“ (s أَمْ), stoji ispred negacije (أَلَمْ، أَفَلَا) i ispred veznika: أَفَلَا، أَوَلَمْ.
grammar.en: The question hamza opens a question and changes no case or mood. According to Ibn Hišām it differs from هَلْ in that it can also ask “this or that” (with أَمْ), stands before a negation (أَلَمْ، أَفَلَا) and before a conjunction: أَفَلَا، أَوَلَمْ.

notes: Counted: INTG (507) and EQ (6). The three INTG uses share one tag, so the page cannot count them apart.

The أَلَا of offer and urging (batch 3) is shown here because the corpus files it as the hamza with لَا (24:22 w18, 9:13 w1); Ibn Hišām treats it as the fifth meaning of أَلَا. Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section ألا, fifth aspect: 'العرض والتحضيض … وتختص ألا هذه بالفعلية' with 24:22 and 9:13 — CONFIRMED.

The view that the conjunction after the hamza belongs to the following sentence is 'the school of Sībawayh and the majority' in Muġnī (الهمزة, 4th rule) — the blind reviewer's earlier removal of Sībawayh's name is reversed; the left-out sentence is az-Zamaḫšarī's.

explanation.bs: Pita da li je nešto tako; kad pita o osobi ili stvari, ta riječ dolazi odmah iza hemze (ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ – „jesi li ti to učinio?“).
explanation.en: It asks whether something is so; when it asks about a person or thing, that word comes right after the hamza (ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ – “was it you who did this?”).

why.bs: „Jesi li ti to učinio s našim božanstvima, Ibrahime?“ – pitanje je o osobi, zato أَنتَ odmah iza hemze.
why.en: “Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?” – the question is about the person, so أَنتَ comes right after the hamza.

why.bs: „Da li ga vi stvarate ili smo Mi Stvaratelji?“ – hemza i أَمْ pitaju „ovo ili ono“.
why.en: “Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?” – the hamza and أَمْ ask “this or that”.

title.en: A question that affirms or rebukes

explanation.bs: Pitanje često ne traži obavijest (a u Allahovom govoru nikad ne traži ono što On ne zna): ili navodi slušaoca da potvrdi (taqrīr – أَلَمْ „zar nije?“), ili kori i poriče (inkār, tawbīḫ). Hemza stoji ispred وَ i فَ: أَوَلَمْ، أَفَلَا. Prema Sībawayhu i većini gramatičara (al-jumhūr), veznik pripada rečenici iza, a hemza je samo stavljena ispred jer pitanje ide na početak; az-Zamaḫšarī je smatrao da je između njih izostavljena rečenica (Ibn Hišām navodi oba mišljenja).
explanation.en: A question often does not ask for information (and in Allah's speech it never seeks what He does not know): it leads the listener to admit (taqrīr – أَلَمْ “have We not?”), or it rebukes and denies (inkār, tawbīḫ). The hamza stands before وَ and فَ: أَوَلَمْ، أَفَلَا. According to Sībawayh and most grammarians (al-jumhūr) the conjunction belongs to the sentence after it, and the hamza is put before it because a question goes first; az-Zamaḫšarī held that a sentence is left out between them (Ibn Hišām gives both views).

why.bs: „Zar ti nismo grudi tvoje prostranim učinili?“ – pitanje koje potvrđuje: jesmo.
why.en: “Did We not expand for you your breast?” – a question that affirms: We did.

why.bs: „Zar se klanjate onome što sami klešete?“ – Ibrahimovo pitanje kori i poriče.
why.en: “Do you worship that which you yourselves carve?” – Abraham's question rebukes and denies.

explanation.bs: Iza سَوَآءٌ hemza više ne pita: s أَمْ izjednačava dvije mogućnosti (hamzat at-taswiya), a rečenica se razumije kao glagolska imenica: „svejedno im je tvoje opominjanje ili neopominjanje“.
explanation.en: After سَوَآءٌ the hamza no longer asks: with أَمْ it makes two choices equal (hamzat at-taswiya), and the clause is understood as a verbal noun: “your warning them or not warning them is the same to them”.

why.bs: „Svejedno im je opominjao ih ti ili ne opominjao, oni neće vjerovati.“
why.en: “It is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them – they will not believe.”

why.bs: „Svejedno im je molio ti oprost za njih ili ne molio, Allah im neće oprostiti.“
why.en: “It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask – Allah will never forgive them.”

title.en: أَلَا: offering and urging, “will you not…?”

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām أَلَا ponude (ʿarḍ, blaga molba) i podsticanja (taḥḍīḍ, odlučna molba) broji kao jednu riječ, peto značenje od أَلَا, i kaže da dolazi samo ispred glagolske rečenice; navodi 24:22 i 9:13. Korpus je bilježi kao hemzu pitanja i لَا, pa je ovdje.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām counts the أَلَا of offering (ʿarḍ, a gentle request) and urging (taḥḍīḍ, an insistent one) as one word, the fifth meaning of أَلَا, and says it comes only before a verbal sentence; he cites 24:22 and 9:13. The corpus files it as the question hamza and لَا, so it is here.

why.bs: „…Zar vam ne bi bilo drago da Allah vama oprosti?…“ – blag poziv da oproste.
why.en: “…Would you not like that Allah should forgive you?…” – a gentle call to forgive.

why.bs: „Zar se nećete boriti protiv ljudi koji su zakletve svoje pogazili…“ – odlučno podsticanje.
why.en: “Would you not fight a people who broke their oaths…” – an insistent urging.

grammar.bs: Prijedlog: imenica iza njega je u genitivu (kasra na kraju: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). Zamjenica se na njega veže kao nastavak (عَنْهُ „od njega, o njemu“). U bosanskom: „od“ s genitivom ili „o“ s lokativom.
grammar.en: A preposition: the noun after it is in the genitive (a kasra at the end: ٱلْأَرْضِ, أَرْضٍ). A pronoun is joined to it as a suffix (عَنْهُ “from him, about him”).

explanation.bs: Udaljavanje od nečega (al-mujāwaza) – osnovno značenje.
explanation.en: Moving away from something (al-mujāwaza) – the basic meaning.

why.bs: „…i od zla odvraćaju“.
why.en: “…and forbidding what is wrong”.

explanation.bs: Uz glagole pitanja i govora: o čemu.
explanation.en: With verbs of asking and speaking: about what.

why.bs: „Pitaju te o mlađacima“.
why.en: “They ask you about the new moons”.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām navodi i značenje „nakon“ (al-baʿdiyya), s ovim ajetom: „stanje za stanjem“.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām also gives the meaning “after” (al-baʿdiyya), with this ayah: “stage after stage”.

why.bs: „Vi ćete, sigurno, iz stanja u stanje prelaziti“.
why.en: “You will surely embark upon stage after stage”.

grammar.bs: Vremenska riječ za budućnost s uvjetnim značenjem: „kada (god)“. Korpus je bilježi kao vremenski prilog. Može značiti i iznenađenje: „kad ono…“.
grammar.en: A time word for the future with a sense of condition: “when(ever)”. The corpus files it as a time adverb. It can also mean surprise: “and lo…”.

explanation.bs: Uvodi nešto što se očekuje ili ponavlja, najčešće u budućnosti, s odgovorom poslije.
explanation.en: It introduces something expected or habitual, mostly in the future, with its answer after it.

why.bs: „Kada dođe Allahova pomoć i pobjeda…“
why.en: “When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest…”

why.bs: „Kada se zemlja svojim potresom zatrese…“
why.en: “When the earth is shaken with its earthquake…”

explanation.bs: Često (ali ne uvijek) iza فَ kaže da se nešto desilo iznenada (iḏā al-fujāʾiyya, Ibn Hišām).
explanation.en: Often after فَ (but not always), it says that something happened suddenly (iḏā al-fujāʾiyya, Ibn Hišām).

why.bs: „…kad ono – zmija koja se brzo kreće“.
why.en: “…and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly”.

grammar.bs: Stoji samo ispred glagola. Uz prošlo vrijeme potvrđuje da se nešto zaista desilo (često „već“). Uz sadašnje vrijeme može značiti „ponekad“, ali u Kur'anu, kad se govori o Allahovom znanju, potvrđuje. Glagol ne mijenja.
grammar.en: It stands only before a verb. With the past tense it confirms that something really happened (often “already”). With the present tense it can mean “sometimes”, but in the Quran, of Allah's knowledge, it confirms. It does not change the verb.

explanation.bs: Potvrda svršene radnje (at-taḥqīq), često uz لَـ: لَقَدْ.
explanation.en: Confirming a completed action (at-taḥqīq), often with لَـ: لَقَدْ.

why.bs: „Uspjeli su vjernici“ – zaista, već.
why.en: “Certainly will the believers have succeeded”.

why.bs: „Uspio je onaj ko je očisti“.
why.en: “He has succeeded who purifies it”.

explanation.bs: Uz Allahovo znanje i viđenje قَدْ potvrđuje (at-taḥqīq), ne umanjuje; glagol ostaje u indikativu.
explanation.en: With Allah's knowledge and seeing قَدْ confirms (at-taḥqīq), it does not lessen; the verb stays indicative.

why.bs: „Vidimo kako lice svoje prema nebu okrećeš“.
why.en: “We have certainly seen the turning of your face toward the heaven”.

why.bs: „Allah zna one među vama koji odvraćaju…“
why.en: “Already Allah knows the hinderers among you…”

grammar.bs: Sestra od إِنَّ: subjekt iza nje je u akuzativu. Ali dok إِنَّ počinje rečenicu, أَنَّ je pretvara u dio veće rečenice („znaj da je…“), obično iza glagola znanja.
grammar.en: A sister of إِنَّ: the subject after it is accusative. But while إِنَّ starts a sentence, أَنَّ turns it into part of a larger one (“know that…”), usually after a verb of knowing.

explanation.bs: Uvodi sadržaj znanja ili vijesti; subjekt je u akuzativu.
explanation.en: It introduces what is known or told; its subject is accusative.

why.bs: „Zar ne znaš da Allah sve može?“ – ٱللَّهَ u akuzativu.
why.en: “Do you not know that Allah is over all things competent?” – ٱللَّهَ accusative.

why.bs: „I znajte da je Allah s onima koji se boje“.
why.en: “And know that Allah is with those who fear Him”.

grammar.bs: Riječ dozivanja: يَٰمُوسَىٰ „O Musa“. Oblik onoga koji se doziva zavisi od vrste imenice: vlastito ime ili jedan određeni dozvani dobiva dammu, a izraz u genitivnoj vezi akuzativ. Imenica s ٱلْ se doziva preko أَيُّهَا. Često se doziva i bez يَا: رَبَّنَا „Gospodaru naš“.
grammar.en: The word of calling: يَٰمُوسَىٰ “O Moses”. The form of the one called depends on the kind of noun: a proper name, or one particular person called, takes a ḍamma, a phrase in a genitive construction the accusative. A noun with ٱلْ is called through أَيُّهَا. A call often comes without يَا: رَبَّنَا “Our Lord”.

explanation.bs: Ime ili jedan određeni dozvani dobiva dammu bez tenvina: يَٰمَرْيَمُ. Gramatičari kažu da je „građeno na dammi na mjestu akuzativa“; korpus ga označava kao nominativ.
explanation.en: A name, or one particular person called, takes a ḍamma without tanwīn: يَٰمَرْيَمُ. The grammarians say it is “built on the ḍamma in the place of an accusative”; the corpus tags it nominative.

why.bs: „O Merjema, budi pokorna svome Gospodaru…“ – يَٰمَرْيَمُ s dammom.
why.en: “O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord…” – يَٰمَرْيَمُ with a ḍamma.

why.bs: „O Harune, šta te spriječilo…“ – يَٰهَٰرُونُ.
why.en: “O Aaron, what prevented you…” – يَٰهَٰرُونُ.

title.en: Calling a phrase: “O children of Adam!”

explanation.bs: Kad je dozvani prvi član genitivne veze, u akuzativu je: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ، يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ.
explanation.en: When the one called is the first term of a genitive construction, it is accusative: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ، يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ.

why.bs: „O sljedbenici Knjige, zašto ne vjerujete u Allahove ajete…“ – يَٰٓأَهْلَ u akuzativu.
why.en: “O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah…” – يَٰٓأَهْلَ is accusative.

why.bs: „O sinovi Ademovi, uljepšajte se kod svake mesdžide…“ – يَٰبَنِىٓ, akuzativ množine.
why.en: “O children of Adam, take your adornment at every masjid…” – يَٰبَنِىٓ, the accusative plural.

explanation.bs: Imenica s ٱلْ se, osim imena Allah, ne doziva izravno: između nje i يَا stoji أَيُّهَا (أَيَّتُهَا za ženski rod), a sama imenica je u nominativu. Najčešće dozivanje u Kur'anu.
explanation.en: A noun with ٱلْ, apart from the name Allah, is not called directly: أَيُّهَا (أَيَّتُهَا for the feminine) stands between it and يَا, and the noun itself is nominative. The most frequent call of the Quran.

why.bs: „O ljudi, ibadet činite svome Gospodaru…“ – ٱلنَّاسُ u nominativu.
why.en: “O mankind, worship your Lord…” – ٱلنَّاسُ is nominative.

why.bs: „O ti umotani!“ – ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ.
why.en: “O you who wraps himself!” – ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ.

explanation.bs: يَا stoji i ispred riječi koja nije imenica (يَٰلَيْتَنِى). Ibn Hišām navodi dva mišljenja: ili se tu podrazumijeva onaj koji se doziva, ili يَا samo skreće pažnju (tanbīh).
explanation.en: يَا also stands before a word that is not a noun (يَٰلَيْتَنِى). Ibn Hišām reports two views: either the one called is understood there, or يَا only draws attention (tanbīh).

why.bs: „…i nevjernik će reći: ‘Kamo sreće da sam zemlja!’“
why.en: “…and the disbeliever will say: ‘Oh, I wish that I were dust!’”

grammar.bs: Negira prošlost, ali stoji ispred glagola u sadašnjem obliku i stavlja ga u jusiv: لَمْ يَلِدْ „nije rodio“. Ibn Hišām kaže da glagol okreće u prošlost; u Kur'anu negira i bezvremeno: Allah nikada nije rodio.
grammar.en: It negates the past, but stands before a present-tense verb and puts it in the jussive: لَمْ يَلِدْ “He did not beget”. Ibn Hišām says it turns the verb to the past; in the Quran it also negates for all time: Allah has never begotten.

grammar.bs: Veznik redoslijeda s razmakom: drugo dolazi poslije prvog, ali ne odmah (za razliku od فَ). Ne mijenja padež.
grammar.en: A conjunction of order with a gap: the second comes after the first, but not at once (unlike فَ). It changes no case.

why.bs: „Zatim je pogledao“.

grammar.bs: Prilog vremena za prošlost: „kad“. Iza njega dolazi cijela rečenica (glagolska ili imenska), koja ostaje kakva jest. Na početku priče (وَإِذْ قَالَ…) mufessiri ga obično objašnjavaju s podrazumijevanim „spomeni (kad)…“. U يَوْمَئِذٍ i حِينَئِذٍ tenvin zamjenjuje izostavljenu rečenicu.
grammar.en: An adverb of past time: “when”. A whole sentence (verbal or nominal) follows it and stays as it is. At the head of a story (وَإِذْ قَالَ…) commentators usually explain it with an understood “remember (when)…”. In يَوْمَئِذٍ and حِينَئِذٍ the tanwīn stands in for a sentence left out.

explanation.en: It most often introduces an event of the past, often at the start of a prophet's story.

why.bs: „A kad Gospodar tvoj reče melekima…“ – وَإِذْ otvara priču o Ademu.
why.en: “And when your Lord said to the angels…” – وَإِذْ opens the story of Adam.

why.bs: „Kad je Gospodara svoga tiho zazvao“ – إِذْ i glagolska rečenica.

explanation.bs: U يَوْمَئِذٍ („dan kad…“) tenvin na إِذٍ zamjenjuje rečenicu koja je rečena prije (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ): „tog dana“, najčešće o Sudnjem danu.
explanation.en: In يَوْمَئِذٍ (“the day when…”) the tanwīn on إِذٍ stands in for the sentence said before (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ): “that Day”, most often of the Day of Judgement.

why.bs: „Tog dana će ona (Zemlja) vijesti svoje kazivati“ – tog dana kad se Zemlja potrese (99:1).
why.en: “That Day, it will report its news” – the day when the earth is shaken (99:1).

why.bs: „Neka lica će tog dana blistava biti.“
why.en: “Some faces, that Day, will be radiant.”

grammar.bs: Prijedlog: imenica iza njega je u genitivu (كَٱلْفَرَاشِ). Piše se spojeno s riječju iza sebe. Uz zamjenicu se ne veže; tada se kaže مِثْلُهُ „kao on“.
grammar.en: A preposition: the noun after it is in the genitive (كَٱلْفَرَاشِ). It is written joined to the word after it. It does not take a pronoun; then مِثْلُهُ “like him” is said.

notes: Review: 105:5 keeps Korkut's „lišće izjedeno“ beside Sahih International's “straw”.
Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section الكاف المفردة: tašbīh; the additional kāf of 42:11 'قال الأكثرون' — CONFIRMED (now 'most').

explanation.bs: Poređenje (at-tašbīh).
explanation.en: Comparison (at-tašbīh).

why.bs: „…ljudi biti kao raštrkani leptiri“.
why.en: “…the people will be like moths, dispersed”.

why.bs: „…pa ih učini kao lišće izjedeno“.
why.en: “And He made them like eaten straw”.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām navodi da je u ovom ajetu kāf prema većini (al-akṯarūn) dodatna (zāʾida) i pojačava: „ništa nije kao On“; drugi je tumače drugačije.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām reports that in this ayah the kāf is, for most (al-akṯarūn), additional (zāʾida) and emphatic: “there is nothing like Him”; others explain it differently.

why.bs: „Ništa nije kao On“ – كَمِثْلِهِۦ.
why.en: “There is nothing like unto Him” – كَمِثْلِهِۦ.

grammar.bs: Veznik izbora: „ili“. Riječ iza njega dijeli padež ili način riječi s kojom je povezana. Kasniji gramatičari mu nabrajaju mnoga značenja (izbor, neizvjesnost, nejasnoća, raspodjela…); prema Ibn Hišāmu أَوْ znači „jedno od dvoga (ili više)“, može prijeći u značenje بَلْ ili وَ, a ostala značenja daje kontekst.
grammar.en: A conjunction of choice: “or”. The word after it shares the case or mood of the word it is joined to. Later grammarians list many meanings (choice, doubt, vagueness, division…); according to Ibn Hišām أَوْ means “one of the two (or more)”, can come to mean بَلْ or وَ, and the other senses come from the context.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb

37:147 as Muġnī reports it (أو, meaning 6): al-Farrāʾ بَلْ, some Kufans وَ, the Basrans ibhām / taḫyīr / the viewer's doubt (Ibn Ǧinnī). The grammar line follows Ibn Hišām's own tanbīh (أو is for one of two things).

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section أو: REWORDED to Ibn Hišām's tanbīh (one of two things; can mean بَلْ or وَ; the rest from context) and to the 37:147 views as listed.

explanation.bs: Povezuje dvije mogućnosti; druga riječ ima isti padež kao prva.
explanation.en: It joins two possibilities; the second word has the same case as the first.

why.bs: „…da opravda ili da opomene“ – عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا, obje u akuzativu.
why.en: “…as justification or warning” – عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا, both accusative.

why.bs: „Reci: ‘Budite kamenje ili željezo’“ – حَدِيدًا u akuzativu kao حِجَارَةً.
why.en: “Say: ‘Be you stones or iron’” – حَدِيدًا is accusative like حِجَارَةً.

explanation.bs: U „poslali smo ga stotini hiljada ili više“ gramatičari se razilaze: al-Farrāʾ čita أَوْ kao بَلْ („čak i više“), neki kufski kao وَ; basranski zadržavaju „ili“ – nejasnoću, ili dvoumljenje onoga ko bi ih vidio. Ibn Hišām navodi ova mišljenja.
explanation.en: In “We sent him to a hundred thousand or more” the grammarians differ: al-Farrāʾ reads أَوْ as بَلْ (“rather, more”), some Kufans as وَ; the Basrans keep “or” – vagueness, or the doubt of one who would see them. Ibn Hišām gives these views.

why.bs: „I poslali smo ga stotini hiljada ili više“ – أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ.
why.en: “And We sent him to a hundred thousand or more” – أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ.

meaning.bs: da (je), kad bi; čak i da; (želi) da
meaning.en: if (it were), had…; even if; (wish) that

grammar.bs: Uvjet onoga što se nije desilo ili se ne očekuje: „da hoćemo, učinili bismo“. Ne mijenja način glagola. Odgovor mu često ima لَـ (لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ). Iza وَدَّ „želi“ znači „da“ i uvodi želju.
grammar.en: The condition of what did not happen or is not expected: “if We willed, We would have made”. It does not change the verb's mood. Its answer often has لَـ (لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ). After وَدَّ “wishes” it means “that” and introduces a wish.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb

Ibn Hišām's refinement of 'imtināʿ li-imtināʿ' is given in our words; the maṣdariyya view is attributed to al-Farrāʾ and Ibn Mālik as Ibn Hišām names them.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section لو: the three views on imtināʿ; the third, 'the view of the muḥaqqiqūn' (only the condition is denied), followed by Ibn Hišām — CONFIRMED, slightly reworded; the maṣdariyya after wadda: 'established by al-Farrāʾ, Abū ʿAlī, Abū l-Baqāʾ, at-Tibrīzī and Ibn Mālik', others conditional — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Gramatičari je zovu riječju „nečega što se nije desilo jer se nije desilo drugo“; Ibn Hišām, s pomnim gramatičarima (al-muḥaqqiqūn), kaže preciznije: لَوْ sama govori samo da se uvjet nije desio; ne kaže da se odgovor nije desio, jer on može postojati i iz drugog razloga.
explanation.en: Grammarians call it the word “of a thing not happening because another did not happen”; Ibn Hišām, with the careful grammarians (al-muḥaqqiqūn), puts it more precisely: لَوْ by itself says only that the condition did not happen; it does not say the answer did not happen, for that may hold by another cause.

why.bs: „Da hoćemo, učinili bismo ga smrvljenim.“
why.en: “If We willed, We could make it crumbled debris.”

why.bs: „A da je on o Nama neke riječi izmislio…“ – odgovor dolazi u 69:45: لَأَخَذْنَا.
why.en: “And if he had made up about Us some sayings…” – the answer comes in 69:45: لَأَخَذْنَا.

explanation.bs: S وَ ispred sebe لَوْ znači „čak i da“: ono što slijedi važi i u tom slučaju.
explanation.en: With وَ before it, لَوْ means “even if”: what is said holds in that case too.

why.bs: „A većina ljudi, čak i da ti to žarko želiš, nisu vjernici.“
why.en: “And most of the people, although you strive, are not believers.”

explanation.bs: Iza وَدَّ i يَوَدُّ لَوْ uvodi ono što se želi i ne mijenja način glagola. Ibn Hišām navodi da je neki gramatičari, među njima al-Farrāʾ i Ibn Mālik, smatraju veznikom glagolske imenice poput أَنْ; drugi je čitaju kao uvjet čiji je odgovor izostavljen.
explanation.en: After وَدَّ and يَوَدُّ, لَوْ introduces what is wished for and does not change the verb's mood. Ibn Hišām reports that some grammarians, al-Farrāʾ and Ibn Mālik among them, take it as a verbal-noun subordinator like أَنْ; others read it as a condition whose answer is left out.

why.bs: „Oni bi željeli da ti popustiš, pa da i oni popuste“ – تُدْهِنُ ostaje u indikativu.
why.en: “They wish that you would soften, so they would soften” – تُدْهِنُ stays indicative.

why.bs: „…svaki od njih bi želio da živi hiljadu godina“.
why.en: “…one of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years”.

grammar.bs: Tri različite riječi istog oblika. Ispred prošlog glagola znači „kad“ (jedno se desilo jer se desilo drugo). Ispred sadašnjeg oblika je negacija „još ne“ i stavlja glagol u jusiv, kao لَمْ. U rijetkim ajetima znači „osim“.
grammar.en: Three different words of one form. Before a past verb it means “when” (one thing happened because another did). Before a present form it is the negation “not yet” and puts the verb in the jussive, like لَمْ. In a few ayat it means “but, only”.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb

The corpus tags 62:3 لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا۟ as followed by a subjunctive; it is not cited.
86:4 is a qirāʾa question (لَمَّا / لَمَا); the readers are not named one by one.
Sībawayh's 'wujūd li-wujūd' and the adverb view of Ibn as-Sarrāj and al-Fārisī are given as Ibn Hišām reports them.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section لمّا (three aspects): the jussive لَمَّا (lasting to now, expected) and the exceptive لَمَّا (86:4) — CONFIRMED; Ibn as-Sarrāj and al-Fārisī (with Ibn Ǧinnī) as an adverb 'when' — CONFIRMED. Muġnī says 'ḥarf wujūd li-wujūd' without naming Sībawayh; Sībawayh's gloss CONFIRMED in al-Kitāb (OpenITI 0180Sibawayhi.KitabSibawayhi.Shamela0023018-ara1, 'وأما لما فهي للأمر الذي قد وقع لوقوع غيره').

explanation.bs: Prema Sībawayhu, ova لَمَّا je riječ koja kaže da se jedno desilo zato što se desilo drugo; Ibn as-Sarrāj i al-Fārisī je smatraju prilogom „kad“, a korpus je bilježi kao prilog vremena. Ibn Hišām navodi oba mišljenja.
explanation.en: According to Sībawayh this لَمَّا is a word saying that one thing happened because another did; Ibn as-Sarrāj and al-Fārisī hold it is an adverb, “when”, and the corpus files it as an adverb of time. Ibn Hišām gives both views.

why.bs: „Pa kad dođe do nje, bi pozvan: ‘O Musa!’“
why.en: “And when he came to it, he was called: ‘O Moses!’”

why.bs: „I kad se obojica predadoše i on ga čelom prema zemlji položi…“
why.en: “And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead…”

explanation.bs: Kao لَمْ, stavlja glagol u jusiv i negira prošlost, ali prema Ibn Hišāmu negacija traje do trenutka govora i očekuje se da se ono negirano desi.
explanation.en: Like لَمْ it puts the verb in the jussive and negates the past, but according to Ibn Hišām the negation lasts up to the moment of speaking and what is negated is expected to happen.

why.bs: „…a vjerovanje još nije ušlo u vaša srca“ – يَدْخُلِ u jusivu.
why.en: “…for faith has not yet entered your hearts” – يَدْخُلِ is jussive.

why.bs: „…a Allah još nije ukazao na one među vama koji se bore“ – يَعْلَمِ u jusivu.
why.en: “…while Allah has not yet made evident those of you who fight” – يَعْلَمِ is jussive.

explanation.bs: Iza إِنْ negacije لَمَّا znači إِلَّا: „nema duše a da nad njom nije čuvar“. Tako je u Ḥafṣovom čitanju (لَمَّا sa šeddom); neki drugi učači čitaju لَمَا, s إِنْ olakšanim od إِنَّ.
explanation.en: After the negating إِنْ, لَمَّا means إِلَّا: “there is no soul but that it has over it a protector”. So it is in Ḥafṣ's reading (لَمَّا with a shadda); some other readers read لَمَا, with إِنْ lightened from إِنَّ.

why.bs: „Nema nijedne duše a da nad njom nema čuvara.“
why.en: “There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.”

grammar.bs: Označava granicu: „do“, „dok ne“. Ispred imenice je prijedlog (genitiv), ispred glagola u sadašnjem obliku stavlja ga u subjunktiv, a može i otvoriti novu rečenicu (najčešće حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا), kad ništa ne mijenja.
grammar.en: It marks a limit: “until”, “up to”. Before a noun it is a preposition (genitive); before a present-tense verb it puts it in the subjunctive; and it can open a new sentence (most often حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا), when it changes nothing.

The subjunctive after حَتَّى is given as Muġnī argues it (by an implied أَنْ, 'not by itself as the Kufans say'); Muġnī does not name the Basrans here. 2:214 حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَ is read with an indicative by Nāfiʿ, so it is not cited.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section حتى: the genitive and the subjunctive (implied أَنْ, against the Kufans — re-attributed), the ibtidāʾiyya before a sentence and before إِذَا ('the majority') — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Kao prijedlog traži genitiv i označava kraj vremena.
explanation.en: As a preposition it takes the genitive and marks the end of a time.

why.bs: „Mir je ona, sve do pojave zore“ – مَطْلَعِ u genitivu.
why.en: “Peace it is until the emergence of dawn” – مَطْلَعِ is genitive.

why.bs: „Zato se okreni od njih do jednog vremena“ – حِينٍ u genitivu.
why.en: “So turn away from them for a time” – حِينٍ is genitive.

explanation.bs: Glagol u sadašnjem obliku iza nje je u subjunktivu. Prema Ibn Hišāmu subjunktiv daje podrazumijevano أَنْ, a حَتَّى ostaje prijedlog; prema kufskim, sama حَتَّى daje subjunktiv.
explanation.en: A present-tense verb after it is subjunctive. According to Ibn Hišām an understood أَنْ makes it subjunctive and حَتَّى stays a preposition; according to the Kufans حَتَّى itself makes it subjunctive.

why.bs: „I ibadet čini Gospodaru svome dok ti ne dođe ono što je izvjesno“ – يَأْتِيَكَ u subjunktivu.
why.en: “And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty” – يَأْتِيَكَ is subjunctive.

why.bs: „Neće vjerovati u njega dok ne vide bolnu kaznu“ – يَرَوُا u subjunktivu.
why.en: “They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment” – يَرَوُا is subjunctive.

explanation.bs: Prema Ibn Hišāmu, حَتَّى može biti riječ početka (ibtidāʾiyya): iza nje dolazi cijela rečenica, koju ne mijenja, a značenje granice ostaje.
explanation.en: According to Ibn Hišām, حَتَّى can be a word of beginning (ibtidāʾiyya): a whole sentence follows it, which it does not change, and the sense of a limit remains.

why.bs: „…sve dok ne posjetite grobove“ – prošli oblik زُرْتُمُ, ništa se ne mijenja.
why.en: “…until you visit the graveyards” – the past form زُرْتُمُ, nothing changes.

why.bs: „Sve dok, kad smrt dođe nekom od njih, on reče: ‘Gospodaru moj, vratite me!’“ – حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا.
why.en: “Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: ‘My Lord, send me back!’” – حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا.

grammar.bs: Veznik pitanja. Kad uz hemzu pita „ovo ili ono“, povezuje dvije mogućnosti (muttaṣila); kad stoji sama, otvara novo pitanje: „ili zar…?“ (munqaṭiʿa).
grammar.en: A conjunction of questions. When with the hamza it asks “this or that”, it joins two choices (muttaṣila); when it stands alone, it opens a new question: “or is it that…?” (munqaṭiʿa).

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
