The munqaṭiʿa is given as Muġnī describes it (أم, 2nd aspect): always iḍrāb, sometimes bare, sometimes with a denying or real question — kinds, not two rival views.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section أم: the muttaṣila after the hamza of taswiya or of taʿyīn, the munqaṭiʿa (always iḍrāb) — CONFIRMED; the munqaṭiʿa REWORDED (see the note above).

explanation.bs: Iza hemze pitanja pita koja je od dvije mogućnosti; iza hemze izjednačavanja izjednačava ih. Riječ iza nje dijeli padež s onom s kojom je povezana.
explanation.en: After the question hamza it asks which of two choices; after the hamza of equalization it makes them equal. The word after it shares the case of the word it is joined to.

why.bs: „Je li to bolje kao gozba ili drvo zekkum?“ – شَجَرَةُ je u nominativu, povezana sa subjektom ذَٰلِكَ.
why.en: “Is that better as accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?” – شَجَرَةُ is nominative, joined to the subject ذَٰلِكَ.

why.bs: „Da li ga vi stvarate ili smo Mi Stvaratelji?“
why.en: “Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?”

title.en: “Or is it that…?”: a new question

explanation.bs: Bez hemze prije sebe أَمْ prekida prethodno i prelazi na novo (al-iḍrāb, kao بَلْ). Prema Ibn Hišāmu ponekad samo to, a ponekad uz to i pita, najčešće prijekorno (بَلْ أَ…).
explanation.en: With no hamza before it, أَمْ breaks off and moves on (al-iḍrāb, like بَلْ). According to Ibn Hišām it sometimes does only that, and sometimes it also asks, mostly reproachfully (بَلْ أَ…).

why.bs: „Zar On da ima kćeri, a vi sinove?“
why.en: “Or does He have daughters while you have sons?”

why.bs: „Zar su oni bez ičega stvoreni, ili su oni stvoritelji?“
why.en: “Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators?”

grammar.bs: Iz porodice إِنَّ: imenicu iza sebe stavlja u akuzativ, predikat ostaje u nominativu. Izražava nadu ili strah od nečega mogućeg. U Kur'anu iza nje najčešće dolazi zamjenica: لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ.
grammar.en: Of the إِنَّ family: it puts the noun after it in the accusative, the predicate stays nominative. It expresses hope for, or fear of, something possible. In the Quran a pronoun most often follows it: لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: ACC|FAM:إِنّ (129); the uses share the tag. The ta‘līl view is attributed to al-Aḫfaš and al-Kisāʾī as Ibn Hišām names them.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section لعلّ: tawaqquʿ (hope and fear) and taʿlīl 'affirmed by a group, al-Aḫfaš and al-Kisāʾī among them', with 20:44; 'whoever denies it turns the hope to the addressees' — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Allah ne nada se kao čovjek. Ibn Hišām navodi dva objašnjenja: da je nada na strani onih kojima se govori, i, prema al-Aḫfašu i al-Kisāʾīju, da tu لَعَلَّ znači svrhu: „da biste“.
explanation.en: Allah does not hope as a man hopes. Ibn Hišām gives two explanations: that the hope is on the side of those addressed, and, according to al-Aḫfaš and al-Kisāʾī, that لَعَلَّ means purpose here: “so that you may”.

why.bs: „O ljudi, ibadet činite svome Gospodaru… da biste bogobojazni bili“ – لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ.
why.en: “O mankind, worship your Lord… that you may become righteous” – لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ.

why.bs: „Pa mu blago recite, ne bi li razmislio ili se pobojao“ – Musau i Harunu o faraonu.
why.en: “And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear” – to Moses and Aaron about Pharaoh.

title.en: The noun after it is accusative

explanation.bs: Kad iza لَعَلَّ dođe imenica, a ne zamjenica, vidi se akuzativ.
explanation.en: When a noun rather than a pronoun follows لَعَلَّ, the accusative shows.

why.bs: „…a šta ti znaš, možda je Čas blizu“ – ٱلسَّاعَةَ u akuzativu, قَرِيبٌ u nominativu.
why.en: “…and what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near” – ٱلسَّاعَةَ is accusative, قَرِيبٌ nominative.

grammar.bs: Riječ ispravke i prelaska (iḍrāb): odbacuje ono što je rečeno ili prelazi na nešto važnije. Iza nje najčešće dolazi cijela rečenica, koju ne mijenja.
grammar.en: A word of turning away (iḍrāb): it sets aside what was said, or moves on to something weightier. A whole sentence most often follows it, and it does not change it.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām razlikuje dvije vrste: kad odbacuje rečeno („nisu djeca, nego robovi“) i kad samo prelazi na novu, važniju misao, a prethodno ostaje istina.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām tells two kinds apart: when it cancels what was said (“not a son, but servants”) and when it only moves on to a new, weightier point while the first still stands.

why.bs: „I govore: ‘Milostivi je uzeo dijete.’ Slavljen neka je On! Nego, oni su robovi poštovani“ – odbacuje njihovu tvrdnju.
why.en: “And they say: ‘The Most Merciful has taken a son.’ Exalted is He! Rather, they are honoured servants” – it cancels their claim.

why.bs: „Ali vi više volite život na ovom svijetu“ – prelazi na novu misao.
why.en: “But you prefer the worldly life” – it moves on to a new point.

why.bs: „I nikako ne misli da su mrtvi oni koji su na Allahovom putu poginuli. Ne, oni su živi…“ – أَحْيَآءٌ u nominativu, kao predikat nove rečenice.
why.en: “And never think of those who have been killed in the cause of Allah as dead. Rather, they are alive…” – أَحْيَآءٌ is nominative, the predicate of a new sentence.

grammar.bs: Spaja se s glagolom u sadašnjem obliku i daje mu značenje budućnosti: سَيَعْلَمُونَ „znat će“. Glagol ostaje u indikativu.
grammar.en: It joins a present-tense verb and gives it a future meaning: سَيَعْلَمُونَ “they will know”. The verb stays indicative.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām kaže da سَـ nije skraćeno od سَوْفَ, protiv kufskih gramatičara, i da budućnost s njom nije bliža nego sa سَوْفَ, protiv basrijskih.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām says that سَـ is not cut short from سَوْفَ, against the Kufan grammarians, and that the future with it is not nearer than with سَوْفَ, against the Basrans.

why.bs: „Ne, znat će!“ – كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ.
why.en: “No! They are going to know.” – كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ.

why.bs: „Njemu ćemo put dobra olakšati“ – فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ.
why.en: “We will ease him toward ease” – فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ.

grammar.bs: Negira budućnost i stavlja glagol u sadašnjem obliku u subjunktiv: لَن تَنَالُوا „nećete postići“.
grammar.en: It negates the future and puts the present-tense verb in the subjunctive: لَن تَنَالُوا “you will not attain”.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām kaže da لَنْ sama po sebi ne znači „nikada“, protiv az-Zamaḫšarīja; „zauvijek“ dolazi iz ostatka ajeta kad ga ima.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām says that لَنْ by itself does not mean “never”, against az-Zamaḫšarī; “for ever” comes from the rest of the ayah when it is there.

why.bs: „Nećete postići dobročinstvo dok ne udijelite…“ – تَنَالُوا u subjunktivu.
why.en: “You will not attain the good until you spend…” – تَنَالُوا is subjunctive.

why.bs: „…a nećete to učiniti“.
why.en: “…and you will not do it”.

grammar.bs: Riječ pitanja na koje se odgovara „da“ ili „ne“. Za razliku od hemze, prema Ibn Hišāmu ne pita „ovo ili ono“ i ne stoji ispred negacije. Ne mijenja padež ni način.
grammar.en: A word asking a yes-or-no question. Unlike the hamza, according to Ibn Hišām it does not ask “this or that” and does not stand before a negation. It changes no case or mood.

explanation.bs: Pita o cijeloj rečenici. U „Da li ti je stigla vijest…“ pitanje budi pažnju na priču koja slijedi.
explanation.en: It asks about the whole sentence. In “Has there reached you the story…” the question draws attention to the story that follows.

why.bs: „Je li ti stigla vijest o Musau?“
why.en: “Has there reached you the story of Moses?”

why.bs: „…pa jeste li vi našli istinitim ono što je vama Gospodar vaš obećao?“ – odgovor je نَعَمْ.
why.en: “…have you found what your Lord promised to be true?” – the answer is نَعَمْ.

title.bs: Pitanje u značenju negacije: „zar je … osim…?“
title.en: A question meaning a denial: “is … anything but…?”

explanation.bs: S إِلَّا pitanje znači negaciju: „nema drugog nego…“.
explanation.en: With إِلَّا the question means a negation: “there is nothing but…”.

why.bs: „Zar je nagrada za dobro išta drugo osim dobro?“
why.en: “Is the reward for good anything but good?”

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām navodi da su neki, među njima Ibn ʿAbbās i al-Kisāʾī, هَلْ u 76:1 objasnili kao قَدْ: „zaista je prošlo…“, a ne kao pitanje.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām reports that some, Ibn ʿAbbās and al-Kisāʾī among them, explained هَلْ in 76:1 as قَدْ: “there has indeed come…”, rather than as a question.

why.bs: „Je li prošlo (zaista je prošlo) nad čovjekom vrijeme kada nije bio ništa spomena vrijedno?“
why.en: “Has there (indeed) come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing worth mentioning?”

grammar.bs: Nepotpuni glagol iz porodice كَانَ, ne čestica: niječe da je nešto tako, prvenstveno u sadašnjosti, a druga vremena kad to kazuje kontekst (Ibn Hišām). Njena imenica je u nominativu, a predikat u akuzativu; predikat često dobiva بِـ (أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ). Glagol je jer se mijenja po licima – لَسْتُ، لَسْتَ، لَيْسُوا۟، لَسْتُنَّ – i tim oblicima Ibn Hišām odbacuje mišljenje Ibn as-Sarrāja i al-Fārisīja da je čestica; ali nema drugih vremena ni zapovjednog načina.
grammar.en: A defective verb of the كَانَ family, not a particle: it denies that something is so, first of all in the present, and other times when the context says so (Ibn Hišām). Its noun is nominative and its predicate accusative; the predicate often takes بِـ (أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ). It is a verb because it changes for person – لَسْتُ، لَسْتَ، لَيْسُوا۟، لَسْتُنَّ – and with these forms Ibn Hišām rejects the view of Ibn as-Sarrāj and al-Fārisī that it is a particle; but it has no other tense and no imperative.

title.bs: „Nije“: imenica u nominativu, predikat u akuzativu
title.en: “Is not”: the noun nominative, the predicate accusative

explanation.bs: Kao كَانَ, لَيْسَ stoji ispred imeničke rečenice: subjekat postaje njena imenica (nominativ), a predikat njen predikat (akuzativ). Kad je imenica zamjenica, ona je nastavak na glagolu (لَسْتَ – „nisi“).
explanation.en: Like كَانَ, لَيْسَ stands before a nominal sentence: the subject becomes its noun (nominative), the predicate its predicate (accusative). When the noun is a pronoun, it is the ending on the verb (لَسْتَ – “you are not”).

why.bs: „A nevjernici govore: ‘Ti nisi poslanik!’“ – لَسْتَ: „ti“ je nastavak, مُرْسَلًا je predikat u akuzativu.
why.en: “And those who have disbelieved say: ‘You are not a messenger.’” – لَسْتَ: “you” is the ending, مُرْسَلًا is the predicate, accusative.

why.bs: „Nisu oni svi isti…“ – لَيْسُوا۟: nastavak „oni“, سَوَآءً predikat u akuzativu.
why.en: “They are not [all] the same…” – لَيْسُوا۟: the ending “they”, سَوَآءً the predicate, accusative.

why.bs: „Nije dobročinstvo u tome da okrećete lica svoja prema istoku i zapadu…“ – u čitanju Ḥafṣa ٱلْبِرَّ je predikat u akuzativu stavljen naprijed, a imenica je أَن تُوَلُّوا۟; drugi kiraeti čitaju ٱلْبِرُّ kao imenicu.
why.en: “Righteousness is not that you turn your faces toward the east or the west…” – in Ḥafṣ's reading ٱلْبِرَّ is the predicate, accusative, put first, and the noun is أَن تُوَلُّوا۟; other readings have ٱلْبِرُّ as the noun.

explanation.bs: Kad je imenica neodređena, a predikat izraz s prijedlogom (لَهُۥ، لِلْإِنسَٰنِ), predikat dolazi prvi, a imenica iza njega: „nema za njega…“. S إِلَّا negacija postaje ograničenje: „čovjek ima samo…“.
explanation.en: When the noun is indefinite and the predicate is a phrase with a preposition (لَهُۥ، لِلْإِنسَٰنِ), the predicate comes first and the noun after it: “there is not for him…”. With إِلَّا the negation becomes a restriction: “man has only…”.

why.bs: „i da čovjek može imati samo ono što sam uradi“ – لِلْإِنسَٰنِ je predikat, a imenica je ono iza إِلَّا.
why.en: “And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives” – لِلْإِنسَٰنِ is the predicate, the noun is what follows إِلَّا.

why.bs: „Neće imati druge hrane osim gorkog, trnovitog bilja“ – لَهُمْ predikat, طَعَامٌ imenica u nominativu.
why.en: “For them there will be no food except from a bitter, thorny plant” – لَهُمْ the predicate, طَعَامٌ the noun, nominative.

explanation.bs: Hemza pitanja ispred لَيْسَ traži potvrdu; potvrdan odgovor na takvo pitanje je بَلَى („jeste“), ne نَعَمْ. Predikat ovdje često ima بِـ.
explanation.en: The question hamza before لَيْسَ asks for confirmation; the answer that affirms is بَلَى (“yes, indeed”), not نَعَمْ. The predicate here often takes بِـ.

why.bs: „‘Zar Ja nisam Gospodar vaš?’ – ‘Jesi’, odgovarali su…“ – أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ, a odgovor بَلَىٰ.
why.en: “‘Am I not your Lord?’ They said: ‘Yes, we have testified.’” – أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ, and the answer بَلَىٰ.

why.bs: „Zar Allah nije sudija najpravedniji?“ – ٱللَّهُ imenica u nominativu, بِأَحْكَمِ predikat s بِـ.
why.en: “Is not Allah the most just of judges?” – ٱللَّهُ the noun, nominative, بِأَحْكَمِ the predicate with بِـ.

grammar.bs: Upitna riječ kojom se pita o stanju ili načinu. Imenica je: Ibn Hišām to dokazuje time što na nju može ući prijedlog (عَلَى كَيْفَ تَبِيعُ), što se iza nje može staviti imenica koja je zamjenjuje (كَيْفَ أَنتَ، أَصَحِيحٌ أَمْ سَقِيمٌ) i što je predikat (كَيْفَ أَنتَ – „kako si?“), pa nije čestica; a kako stoji neposredno uz glagol, nije ni glagol. Ne mijenja padež ni način riječi iza sebe.
grammar.en: A question word asking about a state or manner. It is a noun: Ibn Hišām shows this by a preposition that can come before it (عَلَى كَيْفَ تَبِيعُ), by a noun that can stand in for it (كَيْفَ أَنتَ، أَصَحِيحٌ أَمْ سَقِيمٌ) and by its being a predicate (كَيْفَ أَنتَ – “how are you?”), so it is not a particle; and since it stands right beside a verb, it is not a verb either. It changes no case or mood in the word after it.

explanation.bs: Pita o stanju ili načinu. Pitanje često ne traži obavijest: Ibn Hišām za 2:28 kaže da je izrečeno kao čuđenje.
explanation.en: It asks about a state or manner. Often the question seeks no information: Ibn Hišām says 2:28 is put as an expression of wonder.

why.bs: „Kako možete da ne vjerujete u Allaha, a bili ste mrtvi pa vam je On život dao?“ – pitanje izražava čuđenje.
why.en: “How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life?” – the question expresses wonder.

why.bs: „Kako da govorimo s djetetom u bešici?“ – pravo pitanje o načinu.
why.en: “How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?” – a real question about the manner.

why.bs: „I kakva je bila kazna Moja i opomene Moje!“ – كَيْفَ ispred كَانَ pita o stanju.
why.en: “And how [severe] were My punishment and warning!” – كَيْفَ before كَانَ asks about the state.

explanation.bs: Najčešće stoji iza glagola gledanja, viđenja ili znanja (ٱنظُرْ، أَلَمْ تَرَ) i s rečenicom iza sebe kazuje šta treba vidjeti. Ibn Hišām objašnjava 88:17: glagol gledanja je tu „obustavljen“ (muʿallaq) – pitanje iza njega nije njegov objekat – a كَيْفَ sa svojom rečenicom zamjenjuje (badal) riječ ٱلْإِبِلِ – „pogledaj deve, način njihova stvaranja“. Korpus ovu upotrebu bilježi bez oznake pitanja.
explanation.en: It mostly stands after a verb of looking, seeing or knowing (ٱنظُرْ، أَلَمْ تَرَ) and with the sentence after it says what is to be seen. Ibn Hišām explains 88:17: the verb of looking is “suspended” there (muʿallaq) – the question after it is not its object – and كَيْفَ with its sentence stands in (badal) for ٱلْإِبِلِ – “look at the camels, at the manner of their creation”. The corpus files this use with no question tag.

why.bs: „Zar ne pogledaju u deve kako su stvorene?“ – كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ kazuje šta na devama treba vidjeti.
why.en: “Then do they not look at the camels – how they are created?” – كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ says what is to be seen in the camels.

why.bs: „Pa pogledaj kakav je bio kraj onih koji su opominjani!“
why.en: “Then see how was the end of those who were warned.”

why.bs: „Zar ne vidiš kako je Gospodar tvoj postupio s vlasnicima slona?“ – po Ibn Hišāmu كَيْفَ je ovdje kao „kakvo djelo“, ne stanje.
why.en: “Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?” – for Ibn Hišām كَيْفَ here is like “what deed”, not a state.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām navodi i uvjetno كَيْفَ, s dva glagola istog smisla; kao primjere uzima 5:64, 3:6 i 30:48, gdje je odgovor izostavljen jer ga kazuje ono što prethodi: „udjeljuje (onako) kako hoće“. Basrani (osim Quṭruba) ne dopuštaju jusiv iza nje, Kufanci i Quṭrub ga dopuštaju; u Kur'anu glagol iza nje stoji u indikativu.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām also lists a conditional كَيْفَ, with two verbs of the same sense; as examples he takes 5:64, 3:6 and 30:48, where the answer is left out because what comes before says it: “He spends however He wills”. The Basrans (except Quṭrub) do not allow the jussive after it, the Kufans and Quṭrub allow it; in the Quran the verb after it is indicative.

why.bs: „On vas oblikuje u matericama kako On hoće.“
why.en: “It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills.”

why.bs: „…naprotiv, obje ruke su Njegove otvorene, On udjeljuje kako hoće.“
why.en: “Rather, both His hands are extended; He spends however He wills.”

why.bs: „…pa ih On po nebu prostire kako hoće…“
why.en: “…and spreads them in the sky however He wills…”

grammar.bs: Dvije riječi istog oblika. Ispred imenice znači „da nije…“: imenica je u nominativu, a ono što se nije desilo dolazi u odgovoru. Ispred glagola podstiče ili kori: „zašto ne…?“
grammar.en: Two words of one form. Before a noun it means “if not for…”: the noun is nominative, and what did not happen comes in the answer. Before a verb it urges or reproaches: “why do you not…?”

explanation.bs: Imenica iza je u nominativu. Prema Ibn Hišāmu to je subjekat čiji je predikat izostavljen („da nije blagodati – postojeće“), a ne vršilac izostavljenog glagola niti imenica kojoj nominativ daje sama لَوْلَا, kako su neki tvrdili.
explanation.en: The noun after it is nominative. According to Ibn Hišām it is a subject whose predicate is left out (“were it not for the favour – being there”), not the doer of a left-out verb, nor made nominative by لَوْلَا itself, as some held.

why.bs: „Da nije blagodati Gospodara moga, i ja bih bio među dovedenima.“
why.en: “If not for the favour of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in.”

why.bs: „A da nije Allahove dobrote prema vama i milosti Njegove…“ – فَضْلُ u nominativu.
why.en: “And if not for the favour of Allah upon you and His mercy…” – فَضْلُ is nominative.

explanation.bs: Ispred glagola u sadašnjem obliku podstiče, a ispred prošlog kori za propušteno.
explanation.en: Before a present-tense verb it urges; before a past one it reproaches for what was missed.

why.bs: „Mi smo vas stvorili, pa zašto ne vjerujete?“
why.en: “We have created you, so why do you not believe?”

why.bs: „…‘Zar vam nisam govorio: zašto Allaha ne veličate?’“
why.en: “…‘Did I not say to you: why do you not exalt Allah?’”

grammar.bs: Iz porodice إِنَّ: imenicu iza sebe stavlja u akuzativ, a predikat ostaje u nominativu. Ispravlja ili dopunjuje ono što se moglo pomisliti iz rečenog (istidrāk). Najčešće dolazi kao وَلَٰكِنَّ.
grammar.en: Of the إِنَّ family: it puts the noun after it in the accusative, while the predicate stays nominative. It corrects or completes what one might think from what was said (istidrāk). It mostly comes as وَلَٰكِنَّ.

explanation.bs: Imenica iza nje je u akuzativu: وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ „ali većina njih…“.
explanation.en: The noun after it is accusative: وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ “but most of them…”.

why.bs: „Allah zaista nimalo ne čini nepravdu ljudima, ali ljudi sami sebi nepravdu čine“ – ٱلنَّاسَ u akuzativu.
why.en: “Indeed, Allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves” – ٱلنَّاسَ is accusative.

why.bs: „Mi smo vam istinu donijeli, ali većina vas istinu prezire“ – أَكْثَرَكُمْ u akuzativu.
why.en: “We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse” – أَكْثَرَكُمْ is accusative.

grammar.bs: Laka لَٰكِنْ (sa sukunom) također ispravlja rečeno (istidrāk), ali ništa ne mijenja: iza nje može doći cijela rečenica ili jedna riječ.
grammar.en: The light لَٰكِنْ (with a sukūn) also corrects what was said (istidrāk), but changes nothing: a whole sentence or a single word may follow it.

explanation.bs: Prema Ibn Hišāmu, kad iza nje dođe rečenica, لَٰكِنْ samo uvodi ispravku i nije veznik, bilo da uz nju stoji وَ ili ne.
explanation.en: According to Ibn Hišām, when a sentence follows it, لَٰكِنْ only introduces the correction and is not a conjunction, whether وَ stands with it or not.

why.bs: „Oni su, zaista, smutljivci, ali ne opažaju.“
why.en: “Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive it not.”

why.bs: „…nego je poricao i okretao se.“
why.en: “But he denied and turned away.”

grammar.bs: Riječ raščlanjivanja: „što se tiče…“. Ono što slijedi kao odgovor redovno se veže s فَـ. Sībawayh je objašnjava kao „šta god da bude, (onda)…“ (مَهْمَا يَكُن مِن شَىْءٍ).
grammar.en: A word of setting out: “as for…”. What follows as its answer is regularly bound with فَـ. Sībawayh explains it as “whatever be the case, (then)…” (مَهْمَا يَكُن مِن شَىْءٍ).

explanation.bs: Često dolazi u parovima: فَأَمَّا… وَأَمَّا… Sama ne mijenja padež; riječ iza nje ima padež koji joj daje ostatak rečenice.
explanation.en: It often comes in pairs: فَأَمَّا… وَأَمَّا… It changes no case itself; the word after it has the case the rest of the sentence gives it.

why.bs: „Što se tiče onoga ko udijeli i boji se…“ – فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ, a odgovor فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ (92:7).
why.en: “As for he who gives and fears Allah…” – فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ, and the answer فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ (92:7).

why.bs: „Što se tiče siročeta, ne ugnjetavaj ga“ – ٱلْيَتِيمَ je u akuzativu kao objekat glagola تَقْهَرْ iza فَـ.
why.en: “So as for the orphan, do not oppress him” – ٱلْيَتِيمَ is accusative, the object of the verb تَقْهَرْ after فَـ.

grammar.bs: Riječ budućnosti kao سَـ, ali kao zasebna riječ: سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ „znat ćete“. Glagol iza nje ostaje u indikativu. Često je uz nju لَـ naglašavanja: وَلَسَوْفَ.
grammar.en: A word of the future like سَـ, but standing alone: سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ “you will know”. The verb after it stays indicative. It often has the لَـ of emphasis: وَلَسَوْفَ.

explanation.bs: Basrijski gramatičari su smatrali da je budućnost sa سَوْفَ dalja nego sa سَـ; Ibn Hišām to ne prihvata (vidi سَـ).
explanation.en: The Basran grammarians held that the future with سَوْفَ is further off than with سَـ; Ibn Hišām does not accept this (see سَـ).

why.bs: „Ne, znat ćete vi!“ – سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ.
why.en: “No! You are going to know.” – سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ.

why.bs: „A Gospodar tvoj će ti sigurno dati, pa ćeš zadovoljan biti“ – وَلَسَوْفَ: لَـ naglašavanja i سَوْفَ.
why.en: “And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied” – وَلَسَوْفَ: the لَـ of emphasis and سَوْفَ.

grammar.bs: Riječ kojom se otvara rečenica da bi se skrenula pažnja (istiftāḥ, tanbīh). Ne mijenja ništa; إِنَّ iza nje je s kesrom, kao na početku rečenice.
grammar.en: A word that opens a sentence to draw attention (istiftāḥ, tanbīh). It changes nothing; إِنَّ after it has a kasra, as at the start of a sentence.

explanation.bs: Najavljuje važnu tvrdnju; najčešće iza nje dolazi إِنَّ.
explanation.en: It announces a weighty statement; إِنَّ most often follows it.

why.bs: „Allahovi prijatelji, zaista, nikakva straha nemaju…“ – أَلَآ إِنَّ.
why.en: “Unquestionably, the allies of Allah – there will be no fear concerning them…” – أَلَآ إِنَّ.

why.bs: „…zaista, srca se Allahovim spominjanjem smiruju!“
why.en: “…Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.”

grammar.bs: Riječ odvraćanja i prijekora: „nikako!“ – odbacuje ono što je rečeno ili pomišljeno. Ne mijenja ništa.
grammar.en: A word of deterring and rebuke: “no!” – it rejects what was said or thought. It changes nothing.

explanation.bs: Prema Ibn Hišāmu, Sībawayh, al-Ḫalīl i većina basrijskih gramatičara kažu da كَلَّا znači odvraćanje i prijekor. al-Kisāʾī je dodao značenje „uistinu“ (ḥaqqan) za mjesta gdje odvraćanje ne odgovara; zato se kod nje nekad stane, a nekad se njome počne.
explanation.en: According to Ibn Hišām, Sībawayh, al-Ḫalīl and most Basran grammarians say كَلَّا means deterring and rebuke. al-Kisāʾī added the meaning “truly” (ḥaqqan) for places where deterring does not fit; that is why a reciter sometimes stops at it and sometimes begins with it.

why.bs: „Nikako! Čovjek se zaista uzobijesti“ – iza كَلَّآ dolazi إِنَّ s kesrom, kao na početku rečenice.
why.en: “No! Indeed, man transgresses” – after كَلَّآ comes إِنَّ with a kasra, as at the start of a sentence.

why.bs: „Ne, znat će oni!“ – odbacuje njihovo prepiranje.
why.en: “No! They are going to know.” – it rejects their dispute.

grammar.bs: Iz porodice إِنَّ: imenicu iza sebe stavlja u akuzativ, a predikat ostaje u nominativu. Izražava poređenje: „kao da su…“. U Kur'anu iza nje najčešće dolazi zamjenica.
grammar.en: Of the إِنَّ family: it puts the noun after it in the accusative, while the predicate stays nominative. It expresses likeness: “as if they were…”. In the Quran a pronoun most often follows it.

explanation.bs: Zamjenica je njena imenica, a ono s čime se poredi je predikat u nominativu.
explanation.en: The pronoun is its noun, and what it is likened to is the predicate, in the nominative.

why.bs: „…kao da su kamile žute“ – جِمَٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ u nominativu.
why.en: “As if they were yellowish camels” – جِمَٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ is nominative.

why.bs: „…čupa ljude kao da su stabla palmi iščupanih“ – أَعْجَازُ u nominativu.
why.en: “Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted” – أَعْجَازُ is nominative.

grammar.bs: Riječ odgovora i posljedice: „onda (je tako)…“. Sībawayh kaže da znači odgovor i nagradu (al-jawāb wa-l-jazāʾ). Gramatičari kažu da glagol u sadašnjem obliku stavlja u subjunktiv kad je na početku svoje rečenice, kad glagol znači budućnost i kad ih ništa ne razdvaja; u ajetima koji su ovdje navedeni ona ništa ne mijenja.
grammar.en: A word of answer and consequence: “then (it is so)…”. Sībawayh says it means answer and requital (al-jawāb wa-l-jazāʾ). Grammarians say it puts a present-tense verb in the subjunctive when it heads its clause, the verb means the future and nothing stands between them; in the ayat cited here it changes nothing.

explanation.bs: Izvodi zaključak iz onoga što je rečeno prije.
explanation.en: It draws the conclusion of what was said before.

why.bs: „To je onda podjela nepravedna!“ – o tome da sebi pripisuju sinove, a Allahu kćeri.
why.en: “That, then, is an unjust division” – of their giving themselves sons and Allah daughters.

why.bs: „…i tada bi te oni za prijatelja uzeli“ – وَإِذًا i لَـ u odgovoru.
why.en: “…and then they would have taken you as a friend” – وَإِذًا and لَـ in the answer.

grammar.bs: Upitna riječ s više značenja: „kako?“ i „otkud?“ (Sībawayh je tumači sa كَيْفَ i أَيْنَ). Ne mijenja padež ni način. Često izražava čuđenje ili poricanje.
grammar.en: A question word with more than one meaning: “how?” and “from where?” (Sībawayh glosses it with كَيْفَ and أَيْنَ). It changes no case or mood. It often expresses wonder or denial.

explanation.bs: Pita o načinu ili porijeklu; ponekad čudi i odbacuje: „kako se onda odvraćate?“
explanation.en: It asks about the way or the origin; sometimes it wonders and rejects: “how, then, are you deluded?”

why.bs: „O Merjema, otkud ti ovo?“ – Zekerijja pita o porijeklu hrane.
why.en: “O Mary, from where is this to you?” – Zechariah asks where the provision came from.

why.bs: „Kako će Allah oživiti ovo (naselje) nakon što je zamrlo?“
why.en: “How will Allah bring this (town) to life after its death?”

grammar.bs: Upitna riječ „šta?“, od مَا pitanja i ذَا. Ibn Hišām navodi više načina da se razumije: kao jedna upitna riječ, ili kao مَا „šta“ i ذَا „ono što“ („šta je to što…?“). Ne mijenja padež ni način riječi iza sebe; kao i مَا pitanja stoji na početku.
grammar.en: A question word, “what?”, from the مَا of asking and ذَا. Ibn Hišām lists several ways to read it: as one question word, or as مَا “what” and ذَا “that which” (“what is it that…?”). It changes no case or mood in the word after it; like the مَا of asking it comes first.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām pokazuje razliku na 2:219: ko čita odgovor ٱلْعَفْوُ u nominativu (Abū ʿAmr), za njega je bolje ذَا kao „ono što“ – „šta je to što daju? – višak“; ko čita ٱلْعَفْوَ u akuzativu (ostali, i Ḥafṣ), za njega je bolje مَاذَا kao jedna riječ, objekat: „šta da daju? – (dajte) višak“. Odgovor se slaže s pitanjem.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām shows the difference on 2:219: for those who read the answer ٱلْعَفْوُ in the nominative (Abū ʿAmr), ذَا as “that which” is better – “what is it that they spend? – the surplus”; for those who read ٱلْعَفْوَ in the accusative (the others, Ḥafṣ among them), مَاذَا as one word, an object, is better: “what should they spend? – (spend) the surplus”. The answer matches the question.

why.bs: „I pitaju te šta da udjeljuju. Reci: ‘Višak!’“ – u Ḥafṣovom čitanju ٱلْعَفْوَ je akuzativ, kao odgovor na مَاذَا-objekat.
why.en: “And they ask you what they should spend. Say: ‘The excess.’” – in Ḥafṣ's reading ٱلْعَفْوَ is accusative, answering مَاذَا as an object.

why.bs: „kada je rekao ocu svome i narodu svome: ‘Čemu se to vi klanjate?’“
why.en: “When he said to his father and his people: ‘What do you worship?’”

why.bs: „A kad ih upitaju: ‘Šta je to objavio Gospodar vaš?’, oni odgovaraju: ‘Izmišljotine naroda drevnih!’“
why.en: “And when it is said to them: ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they say: ‘Legends of the former peoples.’”

grammar.bs: Riječ izbora između dvije stvari, gotovo uvijek ponovljena: إِمَّا… وَإِمَّا…. Ne mijenja padež ni način: riječ iza nje ima padež koji ima u rečenici. Ibn Hišām navodi pet značenja (sumnja, neodređenost, izbor, dopuštenje, raščlanjivanje) – ista koja ima أَوْ, s razlikom što se s إِمَّا govor od početka gradi na tom značenju, a s أَوْ ono nastupa tek usput. Uvjetno إِمَّا (فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم) je druga riječ: إِنْ uvjeta i dodatno مَا.
grammar.en: A word of choice between two things, almost always repeated: إِمَّا… وَإِمَّا…. It changes no case or mood: the word after it has the case it has in the sentence. Ibn Hišām lists five meanings (doubt, vagueness, choice, permission, setting out) – the same as أَوْ, except that with إِمَّا the speech is built on that meaning from the start, while with أَوْ it arises on the way. The conditional إِمَّا (فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم) is another word: the conditional إِنْ with an added مَا.

explanation.bs: Daje sagovorniku da izabere jedno od dvoje (taḫyīr). Iza إِمَّا često stoji أَن s glagolom.
explanation.en: It lets the hearer choose one of two (taḫyīr). After إِمَّا there is often أَن with a verb.

why.bs: „O Zulkarnejne, ili ćeš ih kazniti ili ćeš prema njima lijepo postupiti!“ – Ibn Hišām navodi ovaj ajet kao izbor.
why.en: “O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness.” – Ibn Hišām cites this ayah for choice.

why.bs: „O Musa, hoćeš li ti baciti ili ćemo mi prvi baciti?“ – čarobnjaci nude Musau izbor.
why.en: “O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw.” – the magicians offer Moses the choice.

title.bs: Neodređenost: ne kaže se koje od dvoje
title.en: Vagueness: which of the two is not said

explanation.bs: Govornik zna, ali ne kaže koje će od dvoje biti (ibhām). Ibn Hišām za 9:106 kaže da je to neodređenost, a da je Ibn aš-Šaǧarī pogrešno taj ajet uvrstio u izbor.
explanation.en: The speaker knows but does not say which of the two it will be (ibhām). Ibn Hišām says 9:106 is vagueness, and that Ibn aš-Šaǧarī was wrong to count that ayah as choice.

why.bs: „A ima i drugih koji čekaju Allahovu odluku: ili će ih kazniti ili će im oprostiti…“
why.en: “And [there are] others deferred until the command of Allah – whether He will punish them or whether He will forgive them…”

explanation.bs: Razlaže ono što je rečeno na dva slučaja (tafṣīl). Ibn Hišām u 76:3 riječi iza إِمَّا čita kao stanje (ḥāl), zato su u akuzativu.
explanation.en: It sets out what was said as two cases (tafṣīl). Ibn Hišām reads the words after إِمَّا in 76:3 as states (ḥāl), hence accusative.

why.bs: „Mi smo mu na Pravi put ukazali, pa on zahvalan bio ili nezahvalan!“ – شَاكِرًا i كَفُورًا su stanja, u akuzativu.
why.en: “Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.” – شَاكِرًا and كَفُورًا are states, accusative.

explanation.bs: Ovo nije إِمَّا izbora nego إِنْ uvjeta s dodanim مَا (Ibn Hišām). U svih devet ajeta u kojima korpus إِمَّا uvjeta bilježi kao jednu riječ glagol iza ima naglasno ـنَّ (يَأْتِيَنَّكُم), pa se njegov način ne vidi na završetku.
explanation.en: This is not the إِمَّا of choice but the conditional إِنْ with an added مَا (Ibn Hišām). In all nine ayat where the corpus files the conditional إِمَّا as one word, the verb after it has the emphatic ـنَّ (يَأْتِيَنَّكُم), so its mood does not show on the ending.

why.bs: „…a ako vidiš ikoga od ljudi, reci: ‘Ja sam se zavjetovala Milostivom da ću šutjeti…’“
why.en: “…And if you see from among humanity anyone, say: ‘Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention…’”

why.bs: „…pa kad vam od Mene dođe uputa…“ – فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم: uvjet, a odgovor počinje s فَمَن.
why.en: “…And when guidance comes to you from Me…” – فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم: the condition, and the answer begins with فَمَن.

why.bs: „…Ako jedno od njih dvoje ili oboje kod tebe dožive starost, ne reci im ni ‘uf!’…“
why.en: “…If one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as] ‘uff’…”

grammar.bs: Riječ odgovora koja potvrđuje ono što je negirano: odgovara na negativno pitanje ili negaciju i pretvara je u potvrdu. Za razliku od نَعَمْ, koja potvrđuje ono što je rečeno.
grammar.en: A word of answer that affirms what was negated: it answers a negative question or a denial and turns it into an affirmation. Unlike نَعَمْ, which confirms what was said.

explanation.bs: Na „Zar Ja nisam vaš Gospodar?“ odgovor بَلَىٰ znači „Jesi!“.
explanation.en: To “Am I not your Lord?” the answer بَلَىٰ means “Yes, You are!”.

why.bs: „‘Zar Ja nisam vaš Gospodar?’ ‘Jesi’, odgovorili su, ‘mi svjedočimo’.“
why.en: “‘Am I not your Lord?’ They said: ‘Yes, we have testified.’”

why.bs: „Oni koji ne vjeruju tvrde da neće biti oživljeni. Reci: ‘Hoćete, tako mi Gospodara moga…’“ – بَلَىٰ odbacuje njihovo negiranje.
why.en: “Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say: ‘Yes, by my Lord…’” – بَلَىٰ overturns their denial.

grammar.bs: Imenica količine. Ibn Hišām razlikuje dvije: كَمْ pitanja („koliko?“, traži broj) i كَمْ obavijesti („koliko li…“, kazuje da je nečega mnogo). Obje su imenice, neodređene, traže riječ koja kaže čega (tamyīz), ne mijenjaju se i stoje na početku. U Kur'anu se ono čega je mnogo najčešće uvodi s مِنْ: كَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ – „koliko li naselja“.
grammar.en: A noun of quantity. Ibn Hišām tells two apart: the كَمْ of asking (“how many?”, seeking a number) and the كَمْ of report (“how many a…”, saying there was much of something). Both are nouns, vague, need a word saying of what (tamyīz), never change and come first. In the Quran what there was much of is mostly brought in with مِنْ: كَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ – “how many a city”.

explanation.bs: Ne pita nego kazuje da je nečega bilo mnogo: koliko je naroda uništeno, koliko je bašči ostavljeno. Ibn Hišām za 36:31 kaže da je كَمْ objekat glagola أَهْلَكْنَا, a ne da ga zamjenjuje rečenica iza. Korpus ovu upotrebu bilježi bez oznake pitanja.
explanation.en: It does not ask but says there was much of something: how many peoples were destroyed, how many gardens left behind. Ibn Hišām says that in 36:31 كَمْ is the object of أَهْلَكْنَا, not something the clause after it stands in for. The corpus files this use with no question tag.

why.bs: „Koliko su samo ostavili bašči i izvora“ – ono čega je mnogo uvodi مِنْ.
why.en: “How much they left behind of gardens and springs” – مِنْ brings in what there was much of.

why.bs: „A koliko smo naselja uništili!“
why.en: “And how many cities have We destroyed.”

why.bs: „Zar ne vide koliko smo prije njih naroda uništili…“ – كَمْ je objekat od أَهْلَكْنَا.
why.en: “Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them…” – كَمْ is the object of أَهْلَكْنَا.

explanation.bs: Pita za broj ili mjeru; odgovor je broj.
explanation.en: It asks for a number or measure; the answer is a number.

why.bs: „‘Koliko ste godina na Zemlji proveli?’, upitaće On.“
why.en: “[Allah] will say: ‘How long did you remain on earth in number of years?’”

why.bs: „‘Koliko ste ostali?’, upita jedan od njih. ‘Dan ili dio dana’, odgovoriše…“ – pitanje i odgovor brojem.
why.en: “Said a speaker among them: ‘How long have you remained?’ They said: ‘We have remained a day or part of a day.’” – a question answered with a number.

grammar.bs: Pita o mjestu: „gdje?“. S مَا (أَيْنَمَا) je uvjet „gdje god“ i stavlja glagole u jusiv. Sama se ne mijenja.
grammar.en: It asks about place: “where?”. With مَا (أَيْنَمَا) it is the condition “wherever” and puts the verbs in the jussive. It does not change itself.

explanation.bs: Pitanje o mjestu, u Kur'anu često prijekorno ili očajno.
explanation.en: A question about place, in the Quran often reproachful or despairing.

why.bs: „Pa kuda idete?“
why.en: “So where are you going?”

why.bs: „…čovjek će reći: ‘Kuda da se bježi?’“ – ٱلْمَفَرُّ u nominativu.
why.en: “Man will say: ‘Where is the escape?’” – ٱلْمَفَرُّ is nominative.

explanation.bs: Kao uvjet stavlja glagol uvjeta i glagol odgovora u jusiv.
explanation.en: As a condition it puts the verb of the condition and that of the answer in the jussive.

why.bs: „Ma gdje bili, stići će vas smrt“ – تَكُونُوا i يُدْرِككُّمُ u jusivu.
why.en: “Wherever you may be, death will overtake you” – تَكُونُوا and يُدْرِككُّمُ are jussive.

why.bs: „…pa kud god se okrenete, tamo je Allahovo lice“ – تُوَلُّوا u jusivu.
why.en: “…so wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah” – تُوَلُّوا is jussive.

meaning.bs: kamo sreće da, da je bar

grammar.bs: Iz porodice إِنَّ: imenicu iza sebe stavlja u akuzativ, predikat ostaje u nominativu. Izražava želju, prema Ibn Hišāmu najčešće za nečim nemogućim, rjeđe za mogućim. U Kur'anu je najčešće يَٰلَيْتَنِى „kamo sreće da sam ja…“, na Sudnjem danu.
grammar.en: Of the إِنَّ family: it puts the noun after it in the accusative, the predicate stays nominative. It expresses a wish, according to Ibn Hišām mostly for the impossible, more rarely for the possible. In the Quran it is mostly يَٰلَيْتَنِى “oh, I wish that I…”, on the Day of Judgement.

explanation.bs: Zamjenica ـنِى je njena imenica, a glagolska rečenica predikat.
explanation.en: The pronoun ـنِى is its noun, and the verbal clause its predicate.

why.bs: „…i reći će: ‘Kamo sreće da sam za život svoj unaprijed nešto poslao!’“
why.en: “He will say: ‘Oh, I wish I had sent ahead for my life.’”

why.bs: „…‘Kamo sreće da sam zemlja!’“
why.en: “…‘Oh, I wish that I were dust!’”

grammar.bs: Pita o vremenu: „kada?“. Ne mijenja padež; iza nje u Kur'anu dolazi imenska rečenica.
grammar.en: It asks about time: “when?”. It changes no case; in the Quran a nominal sentence follows it.

explanation.bs: Nevjernici je koriste ismijavajući obećanje; vjernici u nevolji pitaju za pomoć.
explanation.en: Disbelievers use it mocking the promise; believers in hardship ask about help.

why.bs: „I govore: ‘Kada će se ispuniti to obećanje, ako istinu govorite?’“
why.en: “And they say: ‘When is this promise, if you should be truthful?’”

why.bs: „…‘Kada će Allahova pomoć?’ Allahova pomoć je, zaista, blizu!“
why.en: “…‘When is the help of Allah?’ Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.”

grammar.bs: Olakšano كَأَنَّ: znači isto, „kao da“, i ostaje u porodici إِنَّ, ali se njena imenica ne izgovara – podrazumijeva se zamjenica – a predikat je cijela rečenica. U Kur'anu iza nje svih devet puta dolazi لَمْ: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَا – „kao da u njima nisu ni boravili“.
grammar.en: The lightened كَأَنَّ: it means the same, “as if”, and stays in the إِنَّ family, but its noun is not spoken – a pronoun is understood – and its predicate is a whole sentence. In the Quran all nine times لَمْ follows it: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَا – “as if they had never lived there”.

explanation.bs: Poređenje sa stanjem kojeg nije bilo: ljudi koji su nestali kao da nikad nisu ni živjeli, čovjek koji se okreće kao da nije čuo.
explanation.en: A comparison with a state that never was: people who perished as if they had never lived, a man who turns away as if he had not heard.

why.bs: „kao da na njoj nisu ni boravili“ – o Semudu.
why.en: “As if they had never dwelt there.” – of Thamūd.

why.bs: „…okrene se oholo kao da ih nije ni čuo…“
why.en: “…he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them…”

why.bs: „…kao da su ostali samo jedan čas dana…“
why.en: “…as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day…”

grammar.bs: Prijedlog zakletve, kao وَ i بِـ: imenica iza je u genitivu. Ibn Hišām kaže da dolazi gotovo isključivo uz ime Allaha (rijetko uz رَبّ) i da nosi prizvuk čuđenja; az-Zamaḫšarī za 21:57 kaže da je بِـ osnova zakletve, وَ njena zamjena, a تَـ zamjena za وَ, s dodatkom čuđenja.
grammar.en: The preposition of an oath, like وَ and بِـ: the noun after it is genitive. Ibn Hišām says it comes almost only with Allah's name (rarely with رَبّ) and carries a note of wonder; az-Zamaḫšarī says on 21:57 that بِـ is the root of the oath, وَ stands in for it, and تَـ stands in for وَ, with wonder added.

explanation.bs: Svih devet puta u Kur'anu: تَٱللَّهِ, a iza toga odgovor na zakletvu, najčešće s لَـ.
explanation.en: All nine times in the Quran: تَٱللَّهِ, followed by the answer to the oath, mostly with لَـ.

why.bs: „I, tako mi Allaha, ja ću sigurno smisliti nešto protiv kumira vaših…“ – Ibrahimova zakletva; po az-Zamaḫšarīju u njoj je čuđenje.
why.en: “And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols…” – Abraham's oath; for az-Zamaḫšarī it carries wonder.

why.bs: „‘Tako nam Allaha’, rekoše, ‘ti ćeš Jusufa spominjati sve dok ne propadneš…’“
why.en: “They said: ‘By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill…’”

why.bs: „Tako mi Allaha, bićete sigurno pitani za ono što ste izmišljali!“
why.en: “By Allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.”

grammar.bs: Pokazna riječ za mjesto („tamo“), sastavljena od هُنَا, lāma udaljenosti i كَ obraćanja, kao ذَٰلِكَ. U Kur'anu najčešće pokazuje trenutak ili prizor: „tada, u tom času“. Ne mijenja padež ni način. Ibn Hišām je navodi među pokaznim riječima za daljinu, na koje se ne dodaje هَا pažnje.
grammar.en: A demonstrative of place (“there”), made of هُنَا, the lām of distance and the كَ of address, like ذَٰلِكَ. In the Quran it mostly points to a moment or a scene: “then, at that point”. It changes no case or mood. Ibn Hišām lists it among the demonstratives of the far, to which the هَا of attention is not added.

explanation.bs: Pokazuje na prizor o kojem je bilo riječi: tu, u tom času.
explanation.en: It points to the scene just told: there, at that moment.

why.bs: „Tada Zekerijja zamoli Gospodara svoga…“ – kad je vidio opskrbu kod Merjeme.
why.en: “At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord…” – when he saw the provision with Mary.

why.bs: „Tada su vjernici bili u iskušenje stavljeni i jako uzdrmani.“
why.en: “There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.”

why.bs: „Tada je vlast samo Allahova, Istinitog…“
why.en: “There the authority is [completely] for Allah, the Truth…”

grammar.bs: Riječ svrhe: „da bi“. Glagol u sadašnjem obliku iza nje je u subjunktivu. Često dolazi kao لِكَيْ i كَيْ لَا / لِكَيْلَا „da ne bi“.
grammar.en: A word of purpose: “so that”. A present-tense verb after it is subjunctive. It often comes as لِكَيْ, and as كَيْ لَا / لِكَيْلَا “so that… not”.

explanation.bs: Iza لِـ (لِكَيْ) je veznik koji glagol stavlja u subjunktiv. Kad stoji sama, Ibn Hišām navodi da može biti i to, i riječ svrhe poput lāma (prijedlog) iza koje se podrazumijeva أَنْ.
explanation.en: After لِـ (لِكَيْ) it is the subordinator that puts the verb in the subjunctive. When it stands alone, Ibn Hišām says it may be that, or a word of purpose like the lām (a preposition) with an understood أَنْ after it.

why.bs: „…da Te mnogo hvalimo“ – نُسَبِّحَكَ u subjunktivu.
why.en: “That we may exalt You much” – نُسَبِّحَكَ is subjunctive.

why.bs: „I tako ga Mi vratismo majci njegovoj da bi se oko njeno radovalo“ – تَقَرَّ u subjunktivu.
why.en: “So We restored him to his mother that she might be content” – تَقَرَّ is subjunctive.

grammar.bs: Upitna riječ za vrijeme, „kada?“ – Sībawayh je objašnjava riječju مَتَى. U Kur'anu se svih šest puta tiče Časa, Dana sudnjeg ili proživljenja. Ne mijenja padež ni način riječi iza sebe.
grammar.en: A question word for time, “when?” – Sībawayh explains it by مَتَى. In the Quran all six times it concerns the Hour, the Day of Judgement or the raising of the dead. It changes no case or mood in the word after it.

explanation.bs: Većinom pitaju nevjernici, podrugljivo (51:12, 79:42); u 16:21 stoji u tvrdnji („ne znaju kada…“). Odgovor u Kur'anu je da to zna samo Allah.
explanation.en: It is mostly asked by the disbelievers, in mockery (51:12, 79:42); in 16:21 it stands in a statement (“they do not perceive when…”). The Quran's answer is that only Allah knows it.

why.bs: „pitaju: ‘Kada će doći Sudnji dan?’“
why.en: “They ask: ‘When is the Day of Recompense?’”

why.bs: „Pitaju te o Času: ‘Kada će se dogoditi?’“
why.en: “They ask you about the Hour: when is its arrival?”

why.bs: „…i ne znaju kada će oživljeni biti.“
why.en: “…and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.”

grammar.bs: Dozivanje Allaha: ٱللَّهُمَّ je „يَا ٱللَّهُ“, s tim da je umjesto يَا na kraj došlo ـمَّ. Tako ga objašnjava Sībawayh: „izostavili su يَا i dodali mīm kao zamjenu“, a al-Ḫalīl: mīm je ovdje na kraju riječi ono što je يَا na njenom početku. Zato se يَا i ـمَّ obično ne spajaju.
grammar.en: Calling on Allah: ٱللَّهُمَّ is “يَا ٱللَّهُ”, with ـمَّ at the end in place of يَا. So Sībawayh explains it: “they dropped يَا and added the mīm in its place”, and al-Ḫalīl: the mīm here is at the end of the word what يَا is at its beginning. That is why يَا and ـمَّ are normally not put together.

explanation.bs: Kad iza ٱللَّهُمَّ dođe opis Allaha u akuzativu (مَٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ، فَاطِرَ), Sībawayh ga, prema al-Ḫalīlu, čita kao drugo dozivanje s podrazumijevanim يَا, a ne kao pridjev, jer se ٱللَّهُمَّ ne opisuje.
explanation.en: When a description of Allah in the accusative follows ٱللَّهُمَّ (مَٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ، فَاطِرَ), Sībawayh, following al-Ḫalīl, reads it as a second call with يَا understood, not as an adjective, since ٱللَّهُمَّ takes no adjective.

why.bs: „Reci: ‘O Allahu, Gospodaru vlasti, Ti daješ vlast kome hoćeš…’“ – مَٰلِكَ je drugo dozivanje, u akuzativu.
why.en: “Say: ‘O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will…’” – مَٰلِكَ is a second call, accusative.

why.bs: „Reci: ‘O Allahu, Stvoritelju nebesa i Zemlje…’“ – Sībawayh: فَاطِرَ je na podrazumijevanom يَا.
why.en: “Say: ‘O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth…’” – Sībawayh: فَاطِرَ stands on an understood يَا.

why.bs: „Njihova dova u njima će biti: ‘Slavljen neka si, Allahu!’…“
why.en: “Their call therein will be: ‘Exalted are You, O Allah’…”

grammar.bs: Riječ odgovora koja potvrđuje ono što je rečeno ili pitano: na „da li…?“ odgovara „da“. Na negativno pitanje ona bi potvrdila negaciju; zato se tu kaže بَلَى.
grammar.en: A word of answer confirming what was said or asked: to “did…?” it answers “yes”. To a negative question it would confirm the negation; that is why بَلَى is said there.

explanation.bs: Potvrđuje pitanje u cjelini.
explanation.en: It confirms the question as a whole.

why.bs: „‘Jeste li vi našli istinitim ono što je vama Gospodar vaš obećao?’ ‘Jesmo’, reći će.“
why.en: “‘Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?’ They will say: ‘Yes.’”

why.bs: „‘Da’, reče, ‘i bit ćete tada meni bliski.’“ – faraon odgovara čarobnjacima.
why.en: “He said: ‘Yes, and indeed you will then be of those near to me.’” – Pharaoh answers the magicians.

grammar.bs: Uvjetna riječ: „što god“. Ibn Hišām pokazuje da je imenica, jer se na nju u 7:132 vraća zamjenica (بِهِۦ), i da je jednostavna riječ, a ne sastavljena (protiv onih koji je izvode iz مَهْ + مَا ili مَا + مَا). Jusivira glagol uvjeta i odgovora.
grammar.en: A conditional word: “whatever”. Ibn Hišām shows it is a noun, since a pronoun returns to it in 7:132 (بِهِۦ), and a simple word, not a compound (against those who derive it from مَهْ + مَا or مَا + مَا). It makes the verb of the condition and of the answer jussive.

explanation.bs: Ibn Hišām kaže da u 7:132 znači „što god“ za stvar (ne za vrijeme) i da je objašnjava مِنْ ءَايَةٍ – „koji god znak“.
explanation.en: Ibn Hišām says that in 7:132 it means “whatever” of a thing (not of time), and that مِنْ ءَايَةٍ explains it – “whatever sign”.

why.bs: „I govorili su: ‘Kakav nam god znak doneseš da bi nas njime opčinio, mi tebi nećemo vjerovati!’“ – تَأْتِنَا je u jusivu.
why.en: “And they said: ‘No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you.’” – تَأْتِنَا is jussive.

grammar.bs: Riječ odgovora sa značenjem نَعَمْ – „da“. Ibn Hišām kaže da po svima dolazi samo ispred zakletve: إِي وَرَبِّي – „da, tako mi Gospodara moga“. U Kur'anu se javlja jednom.
grammar.en: A word of answer meaning نَعَمْ – “yes”. Ibn Hišām says that by all accounts it comes only before an oath: إِي وَرَبِّي – “yes, by my Lord”. In the Quran it occurs once.
